# _Opinion:_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2a170ec3-8679-46e2-a2a7-bde79e51fe47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Ian Roberts **[scandal in Des Moines](https://substack.com/redirect/847eba25-329c-4cb2-a3f1-9b59b15057d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** isn't just about one man's cruel charade. It's a symptom of a deeper rot--a deliberate, calculated assault on our values by elites who think they know better than Americans in the heartland do.
This **[so-called superintendent](https://substack.com/redirect/53db5c36-649a-453f-add5-fdb61de4e088?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , a man who allegedly faked his identity, broke[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c1e2bf27-c10f-4d07-9f62-821338d69880?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[immigration laws](https://substack.com/redirect/c1e2bf27-c10f-4d07-9f62-821338d69880?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , and **[racked up a rap sheet](https://substack.com/redirect/c3bd55f7-88d5-4a4d-8dae-27cea3259211?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , was propped up by a school board more interested in advancing a progressive fantasy than protecting our children. They ignored red flags--criminal records, community complaints, and reports of this guy flaunting the law--because he checked their ideological boxes. And it's time we called DEI what it really is: a betrayal of the American people.
Picture a fall evening in Des Moines, parents gather at a high school football game, cheering for their kids and swapping stories. These are the moments that define Iowa--hard work, faith, and community. But beneath this heartland pride, a laughable scandal completely undermines what we stand for.
The Des Moines Public Schools superintendent, tasked with shaping our children's futures, was exposed as a fraud who fabricated his entire life story. It was a calculated deception, enabled by school board leaders who ignored red flags and prioritized a radical agenda over our kids. For Iowa conservatives, this is a wake-up call. When we entrust our schools to leaders, we expect integrity, not betrayal.

## **The Cost of Ignoring Red Flags**
The Des Moines superintendent's deception was a cascade of failures. Reports surfaced of criminal actions overlooked, from fraudulent documents to flouting immigration laws. Parents and community members raised alarms, only to be dismissed.
According to local news outlets, concerns about this individual's behavior were repeatedly buried by a school board more focused on advancing a progressive agenda than protecting students. The board **[now points fingers at a background check company](https://substack.com/redirect/c760982d-0d81-4048-8140-25383b786392?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , but that's a weak excuse. They ignored warning signs--multiple aliases, questionable credentials, and consistent complaints--because this individual **[fit their ideological mold.](https://substack.com/redirect/81d90c2a-80e6-4826-a3a0-8f25b37da418?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f989e6d2-eabd-4a19-8197-457242cafd81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Liberal policies in states like New York and Maryland enabled this individual to skirt immigration laws, acquire false documents, and even register to vote. Every legal voter in Iowa deserves a system that respects their voice, not one that hands influence to those who game it. The Iowa Farm Bureau often reminds us that trust is the backbone of our communities--whether it's a handshake deal on a soybean contract or hiring a school leader. When that trust is broken, it's our kids who pay the price.

## **A Threat to Our Kids and Our Values**
The most heartbreaking part of this scandal is its impact on Iowa's children. Schools are where we teach our kids to be honest, hardworking citizens. Yet, the Des Moines school board placed Roberts in a position to be a respected role model by thousands of students. Progressives argue we should "look the other way" because this individual connected with kids. But how dare they suggest that an alleged liar, propped up to push a radical agenda, is the best we can offer our children? Iowa conservatives know better. We teach our kids in Sunday school to value truth, not to excuse deceit for the sake of ideology.
This scandal also exposes a deeper issue: the creeping pervasiveness of radical left-wing policies in our schools. Iowa's classrooms have long been a source of pride, producing graduates who embody the grit and integrity of the heartland. But when school boards prioritize "woke" agendas--whether it's transgender policies or divisive curriculums--over accountability, our kids suffer.
A 2024 report from the Iowa Department of Education showed declining proficiency rates in reading and math in some urban districts. While school choice is a critical tool, the real problem isn't just funding--it's leadership that puts ideology over education. When a superintendent can lie about his entire life and still lead, it's clear the system is failing our families.
## **Standing Up for Iowa 's Future**
Some might argue that enforcing immigration laws or demanding accountability is harsh, especially when kids are involved. But Iowa conservatives don't buy the narrative that enforcing the law makes us the bad guys. We don't excuse child endangerment or abandonment, so why should we give a pass to a criminal alien leading our schools? U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is doing its job--protecting our communities from those who break the law. The real villains are the enablers who let this deception fester, from coastal states handing out fraudulent documents to local boards ignoring red flags.
This isn't about hate; it's about fairness. Iowa's farmers, small business owners, and working families play by the rules. They work hard, follow the law, and expect the same from those in charge of their kids. When we allow leaders to bypass accountability, we erode the values that make Iowa strong--honesty, hard work, and community trust. The Des Moines scandal is a stark reminder that if we don't stand up to radical political agendas, they'll take deep root and override our society.
## **A Call to Action: Reclaim Our Schools**
Iowa conservatives, it's time to act. We can't let distant bureaucrats or local enablers dictate our children's future. Start by demanding transparency from our school boards. Attend meetings, ask hard questions, and hold leaders accountable for who they hire and what they teach. Support candidates for school boards and the state legislature who prioritize integrity, parental rights, and local control over federal mandates or progressive experiments. The Iowa Secretary of State's website makes it easy to register to vote or contact your representatives--use it.
We must also reject the left's narrative that enforcing laws is cruel. Our kids deserve role models who embody the values we cherish, not frauds propped up by ideology. By standing firm, we can ensure our schools reflect the heartland's strength--honest, resilient, and rooted in faith.
Like the corn that stands tall through Iowa's storms, we conservatives will hold the line for our kids, our communities, and our way of life. Let's reclaim our schools and show the nation what Iowa stands for.

name: Deb Haaland
subject: a broken leg — and a warning for our national parks
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO
body:
I made it down a mountain after breaking my leg — but our national parks might not make it through this shutdown.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=5053%2E400544%2EM3l0Tw)
A few years ago, while visiting Shenandoah National Park, I took _a bit_ of a tumble.
I was hiking up the side of a mountain when I slipped on a loose rock. It was a total freak accident — I couldn’t believe it. But there I was, covered in dirt with a pain in my leg and ankle and three options:
* Get airlifted down in a helicopter
* Take eight National Park staff away from their jobs to carry me down
* Hike down myself

**I chose to walk all the way back down the mountain** — on what turned out to be a broken leg — because I couldn’t stomach the idea of taking our National Park staff away from their work, even for a few hours.
The federal workers who care for our public lands have absolutely crucial jobs to do. They preserve and protect our public lands for millions of visitors each year and for future generations.
**But right now, nearly two-thirds of them are furloughed due to the government shutdown** — and the few still on duty are stretched thin without pay.
Now, **Donald Trump is threatening to make those furloughs permanent** — and if he does, **this could be the beginning of the end for our national parks.**
[**As Governor of New Mexico, I will always stand up for the dedicated workers who serve our state, and I will be a fierce defender for our rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests. If you’re with me, will you donate $5 to support our campaign?**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251014_2_brokenleg.BFPUTr&amount=5&refcode=em20251014-5053&t=2&akid=5053%2E400544%2EM3l0Tw)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251014_2_brokenleg.BFPUTr&amount=5&refcode=em20251014-5053&t=21&akid=5053%2E400544%2EM3l0Tw)**
This isn’t just irresponsible for public lands and the people that protect them — it’s **extremely dangerous for visitors.** People are entering parks without reliable safety updates, road closure information, or enough rangers on duty. For anyone who takes a fall like I did, gets lost, or has a medical emergency, it could quickly become life-threatening.
Meanwhile, parks will lose up to $1 million a day in revenue. The rural communities that depend on tourism? They could lose nearly $100 million in visitor spending.
This breaks my heart.
**But just like the day I chose to hike down the mountain on my broken leg, I am determined to stand up and fight back.**
[**New Mexicans need a governor who isn’t afraid of the tough fights — someone who fights for working people and public lands when Washington abandons us. I can’t win this campaign without you, so please chip in $5 if you can today.**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251014_2_brokenleg.BFPUTr&amount=5&refcode=em20251014-5053&t=22&akid=5053%2E400544%2EM3l0Tw)
Be fierce,
Deb
P.S. In case you’re wondering, not even a broken left fibula could keep me away from our beautiful parks for long. Here’s a photo of me from one of my favorite places to visit, Monument Valley Navajo Tribal Park.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251014_2_brokenleg.BFPUTr&amount=5&refcode=em20251014-5053&t=23&akid=5053%2E400544%2EM3l0Tw)

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Will you sign on to support the Feed Our Families Act?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
The Feed Our Families Act would make sure food assistance programs continue running for 90 days during government shutdowns.
#
Donald Trump’s government shutdown is putting enormous strain on working families who are missing paychecks and experiencing huge delays in government services.
To make things worse, funding for critical food assistance programs is at risk of running completely dry if the shutdown drags on into November, threatening access to food for thousands of families.
**That’s why I’ve cosponsored the _Feed Our Families Act_ to make sure food assistance programs continue running for 90 days during government shutdowns.**
We can’t let billionaires get tax breaks while Delaware kids go hungry. I’m working hard to protect health care and end this shutdown, but in the meantime, we need to do everything we can to help those who are most affected by it.
[**If you’re with me, will you sign on to my petition demanding Republicans fund food assistance programs during the shutdown?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-20251014-feed-our-families-act-petition?source=em20251014-2407&t=1&akid=2407%2E21716%2Ekrk0fc)

name: Andy Beshear
subject: Why I’m visiting New Hampshire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
This race isn’t just about one state. It’s about the country we want to be.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251014_2_beshear.pqhVAo&refcode=em20251014-2&t=1&akid=2899%2E582294%2EMTBFvy)
It's Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear.
I just visited New Hampshire.
Why?
Because the Senate race happening on the ground here is too important to sit on the sidelines. **I’ve endorsed Chris Pappas, who’s in a race to hold a crucial swing state Senate seat here. And I’m doing all I can to ensure he gets elected next fall.**
You’ve heard me say it before: The path forward in this country isn’t left or right — it’s straight ahead.
It’s about showing up, doing the work, and delivering for all our families, no matter where they live or who they voted for.
**That’s exactly the kind of leader Chris Pappas is.**
Chris and I may come from different parts of the country — New Hampshire and Kentucky — but we share a deep belief in something simple but powerful: Public service is about lifting people up, not tearing each other down.
Chris has spent his career working across the aisle, protecting health care, defending reproductive rights, and standing up for small businesses and working families. He’s never forgotten where he comes from — and he never stops fighting for the people who sent him to Washington.
**That’s why I couldn’t be prouder to support his run for U.S. Senate and visit the great state of New Hampshire to help share his message with voters.**
The road ahead won’t be easy. National Republicans are targeting this race, hoping to flip this seat and push an agenda in Washington that would take us backward. Chris is going to need all of us — every voice, every volunteer, and yes, _every dollar_ — to win.
I’m no stranger to competitive elections. I know Chris can’t win this fight without us.
So I’m asking:
**[Will you contribute $5 or whatever you can today to help Chris Pappas win in New Hampshire and bring real, commonsense leadership to the Senate?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251014_2_beshear.pqhVAo&refcode=em20251014-2&t=2&akid=2899%2E582294%2EMTBFvy)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251014_2_beshear.pqhVAo&amount=5&refcode=em20251014-2&t=21&akid=2899%2E582294%2EMTBFvy)**
This race isn’t just about one state. It’s about what kind of country we want to be. One where we look out for one another. One where leaders work to unite us — not divide us.
Chris Pappas is ready to move us forward. Let’s help him get there.
Thank you,
Andy Beshear
Governor of Kentucky
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2026. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20251014-2&t=22&refcode2=2899_582294_MTBFvy&akid=2899%2E582294%2EMTBFvy)**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Talarico for Texas
body:
#
Peter —
Did you hear President Obama give James a shout out on the final episode of Marc Maron’s podcast?
They were discussing where the national Democratic Party has gone wrong. **Then President Obama brought up James as his example of who is getting it right, saying: “He’s terrific. Really talented young man.”**
[](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-launch.bF5RK3&refcode=em251014-1-ak&t=1&akid=116%2E1347274%2EvT7frc)
He applauded James for having conversations in places like Joe Rogan’s podcast — because “it requires confidence in your actual convictions to debate and have a conversation with somebody who disagrees with you.”
Too many Democratic politicians are afraid of unfriendly environments, and they criticize those who go on Joe Rogan or Fox News.
James just doesn’t think about it that way. Like Obama said, “what people long for is some core integrity that seems absent” and “[James’] starting point is, ‘Let me say what I believe.’”
For James, it’s simple: We have far more in common with our neighbors than the billionaires and puppet politicians who are rigging the system against us. And the best way to remind people of that is to go everywhere and talk to everyone — including with people who are different from us.
This is a huge deal. Not only because it’s an honor, but because the fact that our underdog campaign has already caught President Obama’s attention tells you that something really is happening in Texas.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]
From a young age, my parents taught me that voting isn’t just an option — it’s an obligation.
The right to vote is foundational to our democracy. It defines our nation and state, and is the reservoir from which all other rights flow.
And here in California, voting in our upcoming special election is happening right now !
Election Day is three weeks from today, but let’s remember: Tuesday, November 4th isn’t the only day you can vote — it’s just the *last* day. Every day between now and November 4th can be Election Day for Californians.
Every Californian should have already received their ballot in the mail, and I encourage you to vote early in any of these secure and reliable ways:
* By mail — fill out and return your ballot via USPS. Put it in the mail it as soon as you’ve filled it out!
* By dropbox — fill out and return your ballot in one of the hundreds of ballot dropboxes throughout our communities, including at all public libraries. Click to find a dropbox. [https://caearlyvoting.sos.ca.gov/]
* In person — early vote centers will open in 29 counties starting October 25th. Find one near you by clicking here. [https://caearlyvoting.sos.ca.gov/]
Voting early ensures your ballot is received and counted in plenty of time — but of course, you can also vote in person on Tuesday, November 4th.
However you vote — make sure you do it!
For more voting information, including all the ways you can go vote and how to track your ballot, click here. [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections]
Thanks for reading,
Rob
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]
Rob Bonta
Attorney General of California
P.S. If you’re not registered to vote or need to update your address, there’s still time to do it online [https://registertovote.ca.gov/] or in person ahead of the October 20th deadline.

# **Senate Republicans Need to Come Back to Work**
_Senate Democrats are ready to pass the Pennsylvania budget and end the impasse_ [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170826.172212.67&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15719)
## **What to Know **
* Pennsylvania's budget is over 100 days late
* The PA House sent a budget to the Senate, for the second time, last week
* But PA Senate Republicans decided to block a vote by going home
* PA Senate Democrats remain ready to vote
* Schools, county health programs, and individuals who rely on state funding are being starved of funding because Senate Republicans have decided to stall this year's budget process

**We need Senate Republicans to come back to work**
* * *
[](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170826.172212.67&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15720)
* * *
## **Looking for Leadership **
Senator Hughes and Senate Democrats have been asking Senate Republicans for months to end the budget impasse. Republicans have the Senate majority, yet we've seen very little leadership from them over the past several months. Senator Hughes and Senate Democrats have been ready to vote and fund the state. We've made countless unanswered pleas to Senate Republicans to finish the job, but we will not give up. [Today, all 23 members of the Senate Democratic Caucus shared a letter ](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170826.172212.67&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15721)with Senate Republican leadership demanding that they bring the Senate back to work to finish the budget. [**Read the Letter Online**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170826.172212.67&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15721)
* * *
_... In response to the House's efforts, and instead of staying in Harrisburg to vote on SB 160, you sent the Senate home until October 20, 2005. Sending us home without a vote is a slap in the face to the counties, school districts, human service providers, and others who are struggling to navigate this unnecessary, politically motivated impasse. That is unacceptable. _ _We demand that you call the Senate back to session this week so the Senate can concur on SB 160 and send it to Governor Shapiro for his signature. If put up for a vote, we believe SB 160 will pass with strong bipartisan support ..._ \- Pennsylvania Senate Democratic Caucus -
* * *
## **Join Us in Demanding Senate Republican Leadership Finish the Job**
Call Senate Republican leadership and ask them to come back to work:
* President Pro Tempore, Senator Kim Ward: 724-600-7002
* Majority Leader, Senator Joe Pittman: 724-357-0151
* Majority Appropriations Chair, Senator Scott Martin: 717-397-1309

**Senate Democrats have been ready to put the people of Pennsylvania first and get a budget done. We 've negotiated, we've compromised, and now it's time to pass a budget. **
* * *

## Hamas Killings Imperil Cease-Fire
The fragile Middle East cease-fire deal was [thrown into doubt Tuesday by Hamas’](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3u4yAUxE9jd1jwDHFSUGyTLttuaWHzsN-KjwhwSG6_cqQ9wb8bzUgz-s2fx_ww5Cluv01AXV2aI7bisVbM826CKfjG9aiUYtlTwC15m48ZOCgmOBNqtob8Z5a91Q4RcOxRi-nCFYCSU79rIUGuy41LLhfhxnWycuFmRLMK6QyfetJnm-BCCc4BLgO_KnU16BZ5m0DapZMcLdWUh7-JYt3R-U96YR7WFHqv91qfpRt_dXDv4N5aG1x6nxRnfjope9vBveYjPBmVcmBhljKyZnKkuLEvJ7MpVmapmBxYw_-q7hj6rO2zkfdULlMn-RYM-e96_dFlLw3_AgAA__-ueoLa) defiance and brutal tactics, just a day after the release of the last 20 living Israeli hostages. The group failed to return the remains of all 28 deceased hostages by the 72-hour deadline, delivering only four bodies on Monday, with four more expected on Tuesday, but not received. [Follow live updates here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ_GdKD1xsakcPE3dPnbK9ESL2EjgxF2wuXtTznp7gWuHI00o-_7uAwXkijr7T8t7MuUhpWPHLkU3oeZFsr8yddHkbTmOS18SzHsjwEBba2h1nYIJPE1mCr4iRn5VLHXrgWLaI2rZu_OQCOMLiBPHRDQ2Fpq2Yb2ymScrsS_1zRoqwEQ2wY6azviaTRnhyaMygAHKWlv7knWMvMUX-nJe3NNSxX9XMqW1emfwl5hfxxHc99SLu9WYS95J471m0phH3jiNfNP_MUwCvsoT64fW6DCue4cnDpX7T5sh8QouXXKwG0hid-35U-unh6_AgAA__-_VHyR). Instead of moving toward disarmament as required by the peace plan, Hamas deployed about 7,000 armed security forces to “cleanse Gaza,” leading to [public executions of alleged](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLESnCAURb8GO3bgLahbUKSx27QpHZSHvAyKA7jGv8-4TT4gzW3uzJl77q_3-LYUaVt-2hVN9Wnc8CwRa8U8Brvagn9wPiqlrYS04pKiy8cIAjSXgks9OkvxGlXjjEcEfDZoZNcKDaBV1wTjoEX3ErJXuveTF70Uk3a9n3Dubdc9GzI3TQqppRAA7UP0WvcW_aReHSg3MSXQUU358TvRVgP6eKUP5sec1iaaUOte2PMHg4HBsF17KvWuGAw3mMEgxR2KwXCmHB2_FRkMXz0ebOH7MUWa-T9VHtKRC7e-YuaFlo22he9oZ-Q1o60XP6kGTiVbjAyGJhu3nxQjlbZjSiyrpfjdV__r1I-BvwEAAP__APOMiQ) Israeli collaborators and deadly clashes with rival clans. President Trump, acknowledging the deal’s instability, [warned that Phase Two “begins right NOW!!!](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAUheGnMV2iywUMFBQrrdxlq5WmtLC5jhlhYwFOJm8_yrzCtOdIX_F_3Mabjynu939-I9eWPO70rIlaozKufvOVvmg-W8x7XfNG95xCOUcEVBcOF67G4GN6jZIFtxAhCUaO6x4UopKarY5mqa0xRHbiYtJSBKPMAiDA-t5Iy6J7axy44gCI_RWMUsbTMkmrUYapk0AhtlyunznubaUlvfKDynXOG0tube2onfjT4dDh0MrZ1prn6NP7f48SCvn0N-8-hf_l3I4OhyPXVjscOFdCC9VbQGOtNgpYceF4xpRi7XUn4b75-EOx9qs-D4ffAQAA___5YHcb)" and that if Hamas won’t disarm, “we will disarm them."
## Typhoon Halong Ravages Western Alaska
The remnants of Typhoon Halong [slammed into western Alaska's](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGy3CAYg0-DO3bgX7A3BUUady9tSg9rZJsE83uAfc7m9BnnCq9RI803kn5-TB8-ppjXH36HawtPGWdNaA1l2vzuK_5gfrXIuW68Y-UUymsiRVZqJbWdgo_pPZkuuAUg3Ds4PfTKElkzdJsbHgFDT3NQAd4SegzW6OFptJkRFLroLppW2mqliPqbelj78Fie5ttAJjyFUQixcbn94pjbhiW9-RPlNvPeJbe1dlRx_y5oFDTm98G1XZag8QILGrW65C5oPLmkIK-JgsYDfCTIPdYa8yoD_0WusqDOLwQZszxRG0qWPvn620u_NBTZ3sfGnOXmE-f1yu_Z51bl7F8V8owB9SjwQS6JOcS8Chq74sJxxpRi7Qdh1Lr7mP73b186_dPRvwAAAP__K_2ZcA) Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta, causing catastrophic, record-setting coastal flooding and hurricane-force winds up to 100 mph that swept away homes and caused widespread damage. State and federal agencies, including the Coast Guard and National Guard, [rescued more than 50 people](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1yqzAQRp8GOnm0a4mfQsVt3Pm2KZkFLZYSwTJINuHtM84rpP5mvjPnfNyHO8UU18d_WtiVWYaVj5y4FN6HQAtl_ubpWaKsOcjCD0l-fw6o0SrQCuzgKaZzMLV3MzPytWYHbaMtojVtHVzXTS14P09I3Pbk9dwTeGDTo6ErUh3d-w00WNAasbnoztqOeB5N36LxY2U0-1hkv3xKXEvgOZ3y4v0yyVInF0rZcnX9V-GtwtvGsiV-TxXeyrkFkVWN9PbJahLKhZKiRPmLVJBn5qwCvViNzKvKB29F0UGnAuiwB2jq3fntiCnF3LSV0Y-FYvollz_lejn8CQAA__-ta4B0), some from rooftops, from communities such as Kwigillingok and Kipnuk. One person was confirmed dead and two others remain missing as Governor Mike Dunleavy expanded a disaster declaration for the remote region. [Watch a video report here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LtuwyAYxfGnwVssroYMDJXSqEPTtSPi8hGosIlsbMdvX6Wv0PUc6Tf8v2_mZnPJ0_3LjqBbrGaCfSnQGswm2dEu8AS_tlynJdUR7rWEeTUUU3Ei-ESECTaXw_Au6AhAgXWgiRywoFRw2SUNQflBWTd4F6STnjgWrRLABbNnFXmX9UsjmAiCMaVDj5UQykJ0_CwpDw5xDCG3Ovc_NU8tQSxH3WDufR27olNrjwWxN0SviF73fe-PurbVwet_Lbb5hNh1Q-xynN7zx_Z5eQrczTo89lxKXgaJOL6PNpc_sv2rw6bpbwAAAP__3ZNxzw). Officials are warning that the recovery, complicated by severe infrastructure damage and power outages, will be prolonged as winter nears.
## Average New Car Prices Set Record
The average price of a new vehicle in the U.S. hit a record $50,080 in September, [breaking the $50,000 barrier](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SrCAQhZ9GM6ymFdSA4CZmc9MNrR5olV2UKWDGnbffcl9hsxOc-s7Px22-kQ_-WP_TzqYscT74zIFL4TRvtFPmb7bP4uORt7jzGoNLzxkBlZAgpJod-fCeu9qZhRm5rdnIXoNCVF1fb8Yu0GtUHUs70mgHiVq3EtpREoxAuvbmokmQSgIg6gYGpQbi5d6NPXbuXnXAzpeYms_oj7LxEt7xxamxca-D2Up55Kr9V-FU4XSeZ5MiOTpcSWS_LlOF07Wqwon0CC2Mg7r0ixOtLA4-haUkHslbFs_DF3YiFyqcBe2cvCVxxQkFACBcDIHSBauTcY_Th-Cz7qsO1p18-C1V_vTky-BPAAAA__8WZIcG) for the first time, according to Kelley Blue Book. Expensive electric vehicles and luxury models are driving the surge, with EVs now averaging around $58,000 and Porsche leading all brands at nearly $120,000 per sale. Analysts say the [$20,000 car is effectively extinct](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGupCAYxfGn0Y4JfCOjt6DYxu5uu6Vh5CDfBmUCqOPbb2Zf4fYnJ__8_nxP35Yjb8tvu8JUn6YNZ4moFXkKdrUFb8x75bSVkFYsKbq8TyRJCyWF0pOzHK-pa53xAOHewqj-ITWR7vo2GFK99e5uZa-HxwDYQUlSoC_lZj90umXzeVNSaSUl0eMmB60HC__svnrq3LPpJBzXlG9_E281wMcrHci3Oa1tNKHWV2nuvxoaGxrP87z59H7uhTeU8tk0NEb2KPWKaGjci5htFq_MM4rIsHMQG04ReAki7u89X-JA4DlC4BDFRhRR9rxAbPYDcbJDm417nRwjl0ffdHJZLcf_QfVHioehfwEAAP__prmKCg), leaving budget-conscious buyers to hunt the used market.

name: Teichert in the Trenches
subject: 💥Lethal Weapon Leadership💥
body:
Eleven days into my job as the F-22 flight test squadron commander...
---
| | | | | |
---
| | **💥Lethal Weapon Leadership💥**
---
In the 1987 movie Lethal Weapon, Martin Riggs (played by Mel Gibson) was a young detective in the Los Angeles Police Department. Following his wife’s death, Riggs set aside all concern about his well-being and was willing to put himself in extreme danger to accomplish the mission. He and his partner were massively effective, though a bit reckless, as a result. In 2009, eleven days into my job as the F-22 flight test squadron commander, my boss called me into his office. His first words were: “Dragon, you’re not the guy!” Concerned and curious, I asked him what he meant by that. He explained that I wasn’t right for the job, and had been errantly hired by his predecessor. I asked the obvious question: “Sir, are you firing me?” He responded with the following unmotivational thought: “No, I’m stuck with you, but I just wanted you to know that you’re not the right guy for the job.” I limped out of his office and summoned all the motivation I could muster to address my new 600-person organization at a preplanned Commander’s Call that afternoon. I went home and shared the situation with my wife Melonie. We discussed it, thought about it, and prayed about it. The next morning, I awoke with a God-given peace accompanied by an important Divine nudge. Because the likelihood of career progression was all but over, I could set aside any concern about my potential advancement and seize the right selfless leadership mindset to accomplish the mission. Our organization thrived as a result (and miraculously I got promoted early out of the position with no support from my boss). It was Lethal Weapon Leadership because I had nothing to lose! I’m not suggesting that leaders should act young and reckless like Detective Riggs. Your organization doesn’t deserve the risk that Riggs put his partner through on a regular basis. Importantly though, your organization does deserve something that you can uniquely offer them with such a mindset – selfless, servant leadership. Such an organizational culture is notably absent in a society where most leaders are preoccupied with the next promotion and who selfishly use their current position (and their team) as a steppingstone for the next possibility of progression. When a leader sets themselves aside to tend to the needs of the organization and the members of their team, they uniquely unlock individual talent and fabulously foster collective success. They also create a culture that enjoys a competitive advantage. I would like to think that I would have served just as selflessly without my boss’s unmotivational speech on day eleven and his consistently toxic demeanor throughout my two-year tenure. Regardless, this unique situation gave me two years of practice in setting myself aside to be the leader that my team needed, desired, and deserved. It also helped internalize a mindset that has been the foundation of my leadership philosophy and practice ever since. It was an environment that fostered Lethal Weapon Leadership. Embrace this concept too, and you will LEAD WELL!
* John

| | | | **Teichert in the Trenches**

|
Peter,
With MAGA control of the White House, House, Senate, and Supreme Court, MAGA has backed Democrats into the corner--delivering one cheap shot after another.
The Supreme Court is giving Trump free reign. Soldiers are in our streets. Mass arrests. Suppression of freedom of speech. Corporations and news networks bending their knee to the administration.
We're up against the ropes, fascism on our doorstep. And Trump is going for the knockout punch.
On November 4th, the fate of our Democracy will be decided in an obscure State Supreme Court election in Pennsylvania.
If Trump topples the court's three vote liberal majority next month, he takes control of the body overseeing elections in the most important swing state for the upcoming '26 and '28 elections. He will outlaw mail-in ballots, prevent Democratic ballots from being counted, and may even ban Democrats from appearing on ballots altogether.

And these billionaires aren't fighting fair either. They are sending PA Democrats intentionally deceptive mailers to try and trick them into voting to oust the Democratic justices by saying that voting no (the MAGA position) will "protect women's rights" and that the Justices "protect pedophiles."
Trump and MAGA billionaires are throwing their haymaker, fully expecting it to land and Democracy to fall. But they didn't see this coming.
Defend Our Courts has rallied democrats from across the nation to come to PA's aid. Having now raised over 3 million dollars via 100,000 small dollar contributions from 50,000 unique donors, we have caught MAGA completely off-guard and are delivering crushing counterpunches in PA--proving that Democrats aren't out of the fight yet.
But with only 20 days left in the election, there are only a few rounds left and we're down on the scorecards. If the election were held today, Trump would win. But with you in our corner, we can make a historic comeback:

US President Donald Trump delivers a statement during a summit on Gaza in Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt on Oct. 13. _Photographer: Yoan Valat/AFP/Getty Images_
As I write this from Washington, DC, where most are discussing the government shutdown with no end in sight, I'm at the Washington Convention Center with 30,000 of my brother & sister soldiers, defense leaders, and allies that have gathered for the Association of the United States Army conference, as the world is watching something remarkable unfold.
After two long years of anguish, Hamas has released the last 20 living Israeli hostages as part of a U.S.-brokered ceasefire. Their return came in exchange for roughly 2,000 Palestinian prisoners--250 of them serving life sentences--under a deal that also brought Israel's withdrawal to agreed-upon lines inside Gaza. ([So far, only 7 of the 28 deceased hostages have been returned from Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/4adee179-bce2-450e-8607-b5a246444dff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), violating phase 1 of the ceasefire.)
Beyond the long-overdue return of the hostages, something even larger took shape: a peace agreement uniting Arab, Muslim, and Jewish leaders. President Trump, joined by leaders from Egypt, Turkey, and Qatar, signed the Gaza Peace Declaration in Sharm el-Sheikh, calling it "a historic dawn of a new Middle East."
For the families who have prayed, protested, and persevered since that dark October 7th morning in 2023--when Hamas unleashed the deadliest massacre of the Jewish people since the Holocaust, murdering 1,200 Israelis and abducting 251 more--this is a day of long-awaited, cathartic relief.
It's relief for **Gali and Ziv Berman** , 28-year-old twin brothers abducted from Kfar Aza and held separately in captivity for 738 days.
It's relief for **Omri Miran** , a father of two daughters (4 and 2) whose kidnapping was broadcast on Facebook Live.
It's a relief for my former Wharton student, **Moshe Lavi** , a former IDF paratrooper, whose brother-in-law is Omri Miran mentioned above. For the last two years, Moshe has been among the most vocal advocates for Omri and the hostages, refusing to let the world forget them.
There are so many stories like this.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8fdeeb8b-34d8-45c6-9c41-b83c24c2ed39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Me with the Wharton Veterans Club, March 2023. Moshe Lavi to the right of me._
If my writing resonates with you, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..DNoSAVD_mwr6VmgiSB7SIdd3BlGtnBKZmjmGdbSsmUM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=176227570)
The war's toll has been devastating for Israelis and Palestinians alike. More than 67,000 Gazans have been killed and nearly 90% of its two million residents displaced.
If the ceasefire holds, this will become President Trump's signature achievement and one of the most transformative moments in the modern history of the Middle East.
I've worn the uniform. I've seen the cost of war--not just in lives lost, but in trust broken. So when diplomacy delivers results, it deserves our respect, no matter who's in the room. President Trump's role in brokering this ceasefire and bringing hostages home is a victory for humanity and for the art of statecraft. Even Secretary Hillary Clinton publicly commended his role in the achievement on [CBS News](https://substack.com/redirect/a3b3e214-1a17-428c-956d-db6b1bb4b5b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That's what leadership looks like.
This deal didn't happen by accident. Trump's close relationships with Gulf leaders--cemented over years of personal diplomacy and business ties with Qatar and the UAE--gave him unique leverage at a moment when few others had it. He began both of his presidential terms with state visits to Saudi Arabia and, earlier this year, spent time in Riyadh, Doha, and Abu Dhabi listening to Arab leaders' growing impatience with the war.
Those visits set the stage for what came next: [Trump's 20-point Gaza peace plan](https://substack.com/redirect/7b4b26cc-0dfe-4647-b6a5-560f10a644d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the backing of key Arab nations.
For the first time, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, the UAE, Jordan, Morocco, and even Qatar and Turkey agree on something once unthinkable: Hamas must disarm and give up control of Gaza. It's a rare and historic consensus, the kind that can change the course of the Middle East.
# What Comes Next
For the first time in years, the United States has put a path to peace back on the table. Trump's plan explicitly calls on Israel to renounce annexation and guarantees a credible path to Palestinian self-governance under a reformed Palestinian Authority. It's the most ambitious act of Middle East diplomacy we've seen since Bill Clinton signed the Oslo Accords in 1993.
Whether or not you like President Trump, he is the steward of our nation--marshaling the resources needed to address our biggest problems. After being bogged down in the Middle East for over two decades, with no real political solution, there is a glimmer of hope after the horrific tragedy of October 7th two years ago and the bloodshed that's followed.
For decades, America has been the world's policeman, standing for freedom and human rights. The NATO alliance's commitment to invest five percent of their country's GDP in collective defense shows that others are now stepping up. That's how shared security should work. Strength makes diplomacy possible, and diplomacy, in turn, strengthens peace.
That principle is as old as our Republic. John Adams once wrote to his wife Abigail, "I must study politics and war, that my sons may have liberty to study mathematics and philosophy." His son, John Quincy Adams, later echoed the sentiment, imagining a future in which "his son may be a merchant, and his son may be a poet." The sacrifices of one generation become the opportunities of the next. It makes me think of my WWII Navy grandfather who served in the Pacific, my Navy Vietnam-era father and Army uncles who served in Vietnam, my Air Force brother and I who each did two overseas deployments, and now my Clemson Air Force ROTC cadet daughter Maggie, who makes us all so proud.
This week's events are more than the end of a war. They are the continuation of a promise first glimpsed in the Abraham Accords--a promise that cooperation between Arab nations and the state of Israel can replace bitter feuds with thriving coexistence. It's a reminder that American soft power--our ability to convene, to persuade, to inspire--remains unmatched when it is rooted in moral clarity.
Trump has been on a peace streak since the summer. In June, he helped secure a ceasefire between Iran and Israel through Qatari mediation. Later that month, he was in Washington, where Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo signed a U.S.-facilitated peace agreement. By August, he helped witness a peace declaration between Armenia and Azerbaijan, aimed at ending years of bloodshed in Nagorno-Karabakh.
It's important that these deals hold. It's never guaranteed. The hard work begins now. [Clearing Gaza's rubble may take two decades](https://substack.com/redirect/dea12b67-1d1b-4476-9451-a66f8743b800?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). True peace won't come from signatures in Sharm el-Sheikh but from rebuilding schools, hospitals, and homes and restoring trust.
In the Army, we live by an ethic that transcends politics: _Leave No One Behind._ That creed isn't just about rescuing soldiers. It's about remembering our shared humanity, even in times of division. The families of the hostages embodied that spirit. They refused to give up on their loved ones. They reminded the world that every life matters, every story counts, and every parent deserves the chance to embrace their child again.
As I stand among current and former service members here in D.C., I'm reminded that peace, like freedom, is never self-sustaining--it requires strength, patience, and sometimes, grace. What we're witnessing today isn't the end of conflict in the Middle East. But maybe, just maybe, it's the start of a new peaceful chapter.
***
_P.S. Every time I write something positive about President Trump, I lose subscribers. While I 'm a proud Democrat and have criticized this shutdown and other missteps, I call it like I see it. If you believe in people who put our country first before their political party in words and deeds, please share and subscribe._

The facts about this government shutdown - read more:

| | | | Friends, **We know it’s been a tough couple of days. That’s why we wanted to speak to you directly and tell you what government services could be affected by this irresponsible Republican shutdown. **
🏢 Social Security Administration locations will remain open but operate with a reduced staff. Social Security and SSI payments will continue.
🏥 Veterans Affairs will remain open and continue to take appointments, but plan for delays.
✈️ Though Nashville (BNA) experienced issues due to a shortage of air traffic controllers, most airports, including the Chattanooga airport, do not expect the shutdown to impact their air service or airport operations.
🏕️ National parks like the Great Smoky Mountains will remain open, but search and rescue operations will operate at reduced capacity. Plan accordingly and proceed with caution! ⚠️
🍎 Many local food banks will remain open during the shutdown - check the one closest to you for more information.
We need to look out for each other and be sure our neighbors are taken care of during these trying times. Be sure to check on those you know who might be impacted by the shutdown - every act of kindness makes a difference.
Thanks for all you do in your community. — Tennessee House Democrats

**High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.** **Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.** At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts. **By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch.** She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground.Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks. **She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.** Nancy is fighting to:
* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast
* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency
* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free
* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate
* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think
* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. **South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.**

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zev594rhstgfdas8unikob8ijpllju7ulb6nc538_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clgm9ob2cph2bs)
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2hss4hrkpshtfph215btn380qvfo18iife2972o_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clgm9ob2cph2bs)
What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Limited no-risk trials now available

Not only did they refuse to negotiate with Democrats until the final hours, but they've refused to take accountability for what this is really about.

It's about families having to forgo child care for the month so they can afford a visit to the pediatrician.

It's about seniors on a fixed income whose premiums will skyrocket.

**_It's about the millions of Americans who are going to be unable to afford adequate healthcare if Republicans have their way._**

I don't think it's too extreme to say we shouldn't live in a world where hardworking Americans are choosing between paying their energy bills and paying for life-saving healthcare.

Republicans are looking out for the interests of the 1 percent – but I'm concerned about Delaware and the rest of our country right now, team.

I won't waiver.

**My message to Republicans: fund healthcare – completely – or you will not have my support.**

ABC News anchor George Stephanopoulos **[fled a tense live interview with Vice President JD Vance](https://substack.com/redirect/20b1f453-36ab-46a1-8f9d-0534368a4df1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by reportedly cutting off his microphone after pressing him about whether Trump border czar Tom Homan accepted a $50,000 FBI bribe, which Vance dismissed as "a fake scandal."
"And here's why fewer and fewer people watch your program and why you're losing credibility," Vance told the disgraced T.V. anchor.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/20b1f453-36ab-46a1-8f9d-0534368a4df1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/20b1f453-36ab-46a1-8f9d-0534368a4df1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Vance accuses media of losing credibility:** The Vice President denied knowledge of any evidence supporting the bribery claims and criticized Stephanopoulos for focusing on the story instead of "real issues," telling him "fewer and fewer people watch your program" because of such coverage.
* **DOJ cleared Homan of wrongdoing:** The Justice Department officially closed its investigation into Homan last month, finding "no credible evidence of any criminal wrongdoing" related to the alleged September 2024 incident where undercover FBI agents reportedly offered him cash in a Cava restaurant bag.
* **Latest controversy for embattled anchor:** The confrontation marks another challenging moment for Stephanopoulos, who was recently "apoplectic" after ABC paid Trump $16 million to settle a defamation lawsuit over the anchor's false on-air claim that Trump was "found liable for rape" in the E. Jean Carroll case.

## Trump responds to the incident, ripping "ABC Fake News" for cutting off Vance
"It's inappropriate to cutoff the highly respected Vice President of the United State mid sentence," Trump told a room full of reporters. "I guess its the only way to win an argument."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7b43b436-f6b0-4193-b8df-4b2612ecee5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Washington knows this can't continue. That's why the White House just launched a **$1 trillion push to bring mineral production back home.** 9 10

* Sodium is**1,400x more abundant** **than lithium** , with significant reserves located in the U.S9

The timing couldn't be better. Billions in federal funding are flowing into U.S. mineral projects. Manufacturing is coming back home. And America is determined to break free from China's supply chains.1

# Socialist Mamdani caught with illegal foreign donations
NYC mayoral frontrunner Zohran Mamdani's campaign received nearly $13,000 from foreign donors, with at least 170 of his 54,000 contributions potentially violating campaign finance laws that restrict donations to U.S. citizens and permanent residents, **[Fox News reports.](https://substack.com/redirect/3712872e-e44c-40ba-b0f1-0c1ec2c08839?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3712872e-e44c-40ba-b0f1-0c1ec2c08839?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Partial refunds issued:** As of Tuesday, 91 foreign donations totaling $5,723.50 have been refunded, including a $500 contribution from Mamdani's mother-in-law in Dubai that was returned four days after receipt, though 79 foreign donations remain outstanding.
* **Strong fundraising despite issues:** Despite compliance problems, Mamdani has raised over $4 million in private donations and received $12.7 million in public matching funds, though more than half of his summer fundraising ($562,422) came from outside New York State.
* **Leading candidate in mayoral race:** With Mayor Eric Adams suspending his re-election campaign, Mamdani has emerged as the frontrunner ahead of Independent Andrew Cuomo and Republican Curtis Sliwa in the November 4 election to lead New York City.

# IDF says Hamas returned wrong body, not a hostage, and many more still missing
The Israeli military **[confirmed Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/c0fd118b-5278-4472-8426-9caa410ab75e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that one of four bodies handed over by Hamas as part of the ceasefire deal does not match any of the hostages held in Gaza, following examinations at the National Institute of Forensic Medicine.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c0fd118b-5278-4472-8426-9caa410ab75e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hostage repatriation ongoing:** Under Trump's peace plan, Hamas was required to return all 48 remaining hostages in the first phase, with 20 living hostages and seven bodies already repatriated, while Israel still awaits the return of 28 deceased hostages' remains.
* **Not the first mix-up:** This marks at least the second time Hamas has returned an incorrect body, as earlier this year during a previous ceasefire, the group initially handed over a Palestinian woman's body instead of hostage Shiri Bibas, whose body was returned and identified a day later.

# Rutgers Moves to Oust TPUSA Officers After They Exposed Antifa-Linked Professor Who Fled to Spain
Rutgers director Karima Woodyard **[called for the removal of two Turning Point USA officers](https://substack.com/redirect/12cd3650-9add-49f9-852c-3959ef16777a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , treasurer Megyn Doyle and outreach coordinator Ava Kwan, after they exposed an Antifa-linked professor, claiming they were ineligible to serve because one is a Newark campus student and the other is a graduate student in an undergraduate organization.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/12cd3650-9add-49f9-852c-3959ef16777a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Officers targeted Antifa-linked professor:** The removal demand came after Doyle launched a petition to remove Professor Mark Bray, author of "Antifa: The Anti-Fascist Handbook," who has expressed strong support for antifascism and recently fled to Spain citing safety concerns.
* **Students allege retaliation:** Kwan accused Rutgers of "weaponization of procedure" and "collegiate lawfare," stating the timing suggests retaliation for their public opposition to Bray, and noted they were never alerted to eligibility issues until after their campaign against the professor.
* **University faces competing pressures:** While students are asking Rutgers President William F. Tate IV to publicly support Bray's academic freedom, with a resolution scheduled for Friday, the controversy follows the September 10 assassination of Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk during a campus visit in Utah.

Peter —
I know you get a lot of emails from me. But I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for governor, and why your support is so critical to our success.
**I was raised to believe that we have an obligation to our community and our country.** This country gave my family so much, and it’s always been obvious to me that I wanted to dedicate my life to public service.
It’s why I took my first oath to the Constitution as a teenager when I entered the Naval Academy.
It’s why I spent nearly a decade in the Navy as a helicopter pilot and Russian policy officer.
It’s why I went to law school, and became an Outreach and Reentry Coordinator and a federal prosecutor.
**Peter, it’s why I first decided to run for office.**
In 2017, I watched Donald Trump attack every value that I had spent my life fighting for. And as I thought about it, I realized I couldn’t ask someone to do my fighting for me – that if I wanted to defend the country I love then I had to run toward the crisis.
It was a long shot to run as a nobody in a district that had been held by an entrenched Republican for more than two decades.
**But I knew what was at stake and I knew what I had to do.**
I’m proud of the work I’ve done in Congress — work that earned me the distinction of being named the most effective member of the New Jersey House delegation in just my second term.
**But I know I can do more as your governor. And that’s why I decided to run.**
By winning this seat, we reduce mortgage and rental costs, crack down on shady middlemen making prescription medications more expensive, and bring down utility costs by bringing more clean, cheap power like solar onto the grid.
But the truth is that this is already the most expensive New Jersey gubernatorial race on record. And my opponent is benefiting not only from Donald Trump's personal endorsement — but from the support of Trump's entire network of deep-pocketed, right-wing allies. So I am asking:

Donald Trump _wants_ this government shutdown to hurt. He's bragged about it behind closed doors to his cronies.

Now, the administration is scrambling to find funds for military personnel, reallocating billions from the Defense Department to pay service members. This is a temporary solution, and instead of standing up for the American people and reopening the government, House Republicans are standing in line behind Trump.

name: Mikie Sherrill
subject: As New Jersey goes, so goes the nation
body:
Peter, it’s Governor Wes Moore. The Real Texas PAC said I could reach out today to share some important news with you.
When we first launched our campaign four years ago, I had never run for political office. I was an Army Captain, the son of a single mom, and I ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country.
So I traveled the state, listening to your stories and sharing mine. I heard the same thing again and again: That the career politicians had been telling us everything was great, when we knew it wasn’t.
Ever since I took office, I’ve been on a mission to change that. To lower taxes for middle class families. To make health care and prescription drugs cheaper. To make our communities safer.
But our mission is far from over.
Today, I’m proud to announce that I’m running for another term as Governor of Maryland. Because our work isn’t done yet.
Will you split a contribution of $15 or more to my campaign and The Real Texas PAC now to help power our movement? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-wes-moore?refcode=partner_ms_wes_em_realtexaspac]
While we’ve made a lot of progress over the last three years, our fight is even more important now because of who is in the White House.
The President of the United States is bending over backwards for billionaires and big corporations. He’s firing federal civil servants, gutting Medicaid, and raising prices on everything from electricity to groceries for families. His reckless attacks are hitting Maryland hard.
It’s time for us to come together across counties and party lines to prove that even in the face of dysfunction in D.C.: We can show there’s a better way forward.
We already have Republican opponents in this race, and with the President and his allies working to undo our progress, the stakes couldn’t be higher. This campaign has always been about partnership – I’m grateful to have The Real Texas PAC’s support in this race, and I’d like to have yours too. So please, give whatever you can and split a contribution between my campaign and The Real Texas PAC today. By Illinois Review

Illinois State Representative and Deputy House Republican Leader Norine Hammond (R-Macomb) is drawing sharp criticism from conservatives after campaign finance records revealed she accepted $50,000 from far-left teachers’ unions that have long opposed Republican priorities and the Trump agenda.

According to filings with the Illinois State Board of Elections, Hammond received $10,000 from the American Federation of Teachers (AFT) in 2024 and $40,000 from IPACE, the Illinois Political Action Committee for Education, in 2022.

The GOP bills will make it impossible for many. I live in a rural area, and funding losses will affect staffing that is already strained. Will the hospital that serves close to 50,000 people have to close? Who takes care of my patients when we already have a physician shortage? Pls keep the pressure on.
_– Tavis, Sequim_ I am traveling and am very worried about the scarcity of air traffic controllers. People are hurting, and they are scared.
_– Lisa, Silverdale_ I had an appointment for a virtual doctor's appointment, and the night before it was supposed to happen, I got a call saying I had to come in in person because the teleappointments had not been funded by Medicare. Old people, like me, need that service. Especially in rural areas.
_– Susan, Gig Harbor_ I have a family member who works for NOAA. They are essential workers because the fish at their research lab will die without their constant care. They are studying one of our area's last commercial saltwater fish species, which is critical to our profitable fishing industry. But they won't be doing it for long if the government doesn't continue to support the research.
_– Kathryn, Westport_ Due to glitches in the IRS software, I have had difficulty getting registrations for IRA tax credits for solar panels that our church installed on two low-income rental units. It looked like I would receive the registrations soon. But then, progress has stopped because of the shutdown. I need the registrations to meet our extended filing deadline in November, and time is running short.

name: Voter Action Project Petitions
subject: Stand up for freedom of speech
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks,
On September 25, 2025, the President released National Security Presidential Memorandum-7 (NSPM-7), titled “ Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence .” This memo contains broad and vague language that could allow government agencies to monitor or penalize individuals and groups based on their beliefs rather than their actions.
Terms like “anti-American,” “anti-capitalist,” and “anti-Christian” are so loosely defined that peaceful advocacy organizations, religious communities, or critics of government policy could be subject to investigation—even if they have no connection to violence of any kind. In our current political environment, it means partisan finger-pointing and extremism can be elevated from a difference of opinion to political retribution and punishment with no due process.

| Because California is a blue state, sometimes we forget what it’s like to have the eyes of the nation on us and our election results. But this November, California voters have the chance to shape the future of the entire country with Proposition 50. Prop 50 — Governor Gavin Newsom’s Election Rigging Response Act — is California’s answer to Donald Trump and Texas Republicans’ desperate attempt to redraw congressional maps and lock in MAGA control of the U.S. House before voters even get a say. _If Prop 50 passes, we’ll neutralize that scheme —_ __and keep the fight for the House alive.__ **Here’s what Punchbowl News recently reported:** “It’s hard to overstate the significance of this ballot measure. Democrats could neutralize the new Texas congressional map. Calvert, LaMalfa, Reps. Darrell Issa, Kevin Kiley and David Valadao could lose reelection. **This could very well sway the battle for control of the House.”** They’re right. The stakes couldn’t be higher for passing Prop 50. But even if we are victorious this November, our work isn’t over. clean_body: “hard to overstate significance of this ballot measure” | = | Because California is a blue state, sometimes we forget what it’s like to have the eyes of the nation on us and our election results. But this November, California voters have the chance to shape the future of the entire country with Proposition 50. Prop 50 — Governor Gavin Newsom’s Election Rigging Response Act — is California’s answer to Donald Trump and Texas Republicans’ desperate attempt to redraw congressional maps and lock in MAGA control of the U.S. House before voters even get a say. If Prop 50 passes, we’ll neutralize that scheme — and keep the fight for the House alive. Here’s what Punchbowl News recently reported: “It’s hard to overstate the significance of this ballot measure. Democrats could neutralize the new Texas congressional map. Calvert, LaMalfa, Reps. Darrell Issa, Kevin Kiley and David Valadao could lose reelection. This could very well sway the battle for control of the House.” They’re right. The stakes couldn’t be higher for passing Prop 50. But even if we are victorious this November, our work isn’t over. Far from it. With less than two months to go until we face off against Trump’s handpicked candidate, Matt Van Epps, we can’t afford to waste any time. [I’m counting on your help to flip this seat blue so that I can get to work feeding kids, fixing roads, and funding hospitals. Will you split a donation to my campaign and Blue Amp Action now?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3da1e673-88bc-4032-a7aa-0fe0b4f52ac3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | | I’m an organizer, state rep, and pissed-off social worker running for Congress because we need leadership that meets this moment – and House Republicans aren’t looking out for us. For the past decade, I’ve been at the heart of a long-term political project to take back Tennessee, shoulder to shoulder with fellow organizers, activists, movement lawyers, community groups, and mentors who took the time to teach me what real power-building looks like. Now, I’m taking this fight national, but it won’t be easy, and I’m going to need your help. Special elections matter — I won my first race in one. Now TN-07 is the only red-to-blue special in the country. Flip it, and we gain a seat, Republicans lose one, and 2026 shifts. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. | | | Dear Friends,
In Virginia, we have an opportunity to flip the Governor, Lt. Governor, and Attorney General offices as well as expand our majority in the House of Delegates, but we need your help in the final stretch. The Democratic National Committee is looking for **volunteers to canvass** within the state.
Canvassing makes a real difference, and we need your support on the ground. Let's connect directly with Virginia voters. Volunteers canvassing in **Hampton Roads** and **Northern Virginia** will be **eligible for hotel accommodations** if you are able to stay overnight to knock on doors.
If you are interested, please fill out the form below to sign up.
* **Hampton Roads** :**[Canvassing Interest Form](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=4506c0cf1f&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**
* **Northern Virginia** :**[Canvassing Interest Form](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=de2725cf96&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**
* If you need transportation to and from DC**, [sign up to join a van here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=830e931ea5&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**

**Unable to canvass?** You can make calls for Virginia Democrats! **Virginia Phonebanks**
* Spanish-language GOTV phonebanks: **[https://www.mobilize.us/spanbergerforgovernor/event/860395](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=bc196995f5&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**
* Phonebank for Virginia’s Democratic Ticket: ** [ https://www.mobilize.us/spanbergerforgovernor/event/841698/](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=f704d77a34&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**

Best Regards,
Lorenza Ramírez National Organizing Director Democratic National Committee

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,

Congressman Jason Crow isn’t just _my_ member of Congress—he’s a close friend and one of the most dedicated public servants I know. An Army Ranger turned congressman, Jason fights every day for our Colorado way of life.
**That’s why I’m proud to share that Congressman Jason Crow has endorsed my campaign for Treasurer.**
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=e6fa07b9b7&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | “I’ve known Jeff Bridges for years, and what stands out to me isn’t just his expertise with budgets, it’s his leadership. Jeff shows up, he listens, and he does the work with humility and integrity. **I trust him because I know he’ll always put Colorado families first.** That’s the kind of Treasurer we need.”—**Congressman Jason Crow**

A tribute to Charlie & Turning Point Action—see how to help and double your impact today.
|
---
| [ ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=753d31b6e58e40da9f90d990be6d580f&_e=oe2iTmiwMOFmwtWrN2JJll8HhvoKWkMan9M-kA5NUMBIkL1BB-O-a9U4uZCayWemesLNOn1eKESKKkIjOPqXFf2Nm-Qo-x8Y6ZbYTZTHAMDicWQ7NIqOkWv_Zfad6mxwSly6JWQBO4f0a-uJYg2J_DxpYs8ruse5VANvsmZ-QAM0xfQfe72E-NuZ23HyJVvEslQq-B6eOzesgk0_PKFJbGvIe36KyYm2y-z9C57HBcGIlsw3nmE2VSDozr09R0jFd-ka_NRbUnG9V4cCDARYX85cvcYfobMv12hErd48kcwphgcdJC9175wrfWr9NUT6BBFhA6ZSLYbHg1l0t7RL8Mx3THPK2VfZ6WKVe3KIDNkHkdkHecTz3g9TNZ-tjwh67vNzgjmvpu4cc1dtEkyAnENdSo5tMYMNILnfpcnUiNmciIooNMId_yX2eRueQJK-T-6EaCbG7pj7T3EGBsS2Ben776F5TV8BcjJg7lJAsPkL0a9RbXFuU9ccrV8u8vXq8zjg-u4YBAaS49GVjBf636qJ5c7cJNFzzj5X1RJxg-Q1EZsIMxumtNiO8lFHRUDwEwYku7WdCw07W78Kc5hhhiLnuvAif-aPti-ChHKh9vexfvVVHH5wI495rY3-75L2GHcgikOPzRZ3parP8oShGQ_yR-VQ16xVpp9VhrhMan0fvdEx4h0SNyBAfEbpC4QPxFS3_tCg6m-9Z3BH72aU1g%3D%3D)
---
Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
| [ ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=753d31b6e58e40da9f90d990be6d580f&_e=oe2iTmiwMOFmwtWrN2JJll8HhvoKWkMan9M-kA5NUMBIkL1BB-O-a9U4uZCayWemesLNOn1eKESKKkIjOPqXFf2Nm-Qo-x8Y6ZbYTZTHAMDicWQ7NIqOkWv_Zfad6mxwSly6JWQBO4f0a-uJYg2J_DxpYs8ruse5VANvsmZ-QAM0xfQfe72E-NuZ23HyJVvEslQq-B6eOzesgk0_PKFJbGvIe36KyYm2y-z9C57HBcGIlsw3nmE2VSDozr09R0jFbnny1k3stnmO_jiwpMbeprR4GtwVN_Q7j_aadzkYrbWHRbmFf7ZfQDZds6gwOWAy8A_2Bkj_ivOF-G-J-g_Khtklc-kjXopCxtaFzuvSTt32095OuxoMJUmumSzvfM_vIwVYhHZRbdEhPM0EQNjO5ZchZerdsZ3CYgEFIwOWXwRbhJAPQ6p75c9kgGvcUPKHHMfKwu1hADKaH5usNiGJyu5vkveaNiFZASNnaf4HT5W7wbsyDewMh8BdNH-12y-z6Bm6STRuaAeV_EoWX4QgWkW29b3tM62vqGKhJg8OGplQTKI7X1vr83wfun2qDAWujU52eUft-bns2oo-tEEFJqDZEKUZioW5nWtpJr-9VzwsPRFvCIqWviveG2IDbfRds1VPl4jY66cNjmoySmYsE_90oqZkao9E2bUBUoD_KXK-yOIbVBtWwzuqn7DSDl9PZe0SV0bhlk_W3SA4Rd_vAQ%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
| [ ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=753d31b6e58e40da9f90d990be6d580f&_e=oe2iTmiwMOFmwtWrN2JJll8HhvoKWkMan9M-kA5NUMBIkL1BB-O-a9U4uZCayWemesLNOn1eKESKKkIjOPqXFf2Nm-Qo-x8Y6ZbYTZTHAMDicWQ7NIqOkWv_Zfad6mxwSly6JWQBO4f0a-uJYg2J_DxpYs8ruse5VANvsmZ-QAM0xfQfe72E-NuZ23HyJVvEslQq-B6eOzesgk0_PKFJbGvIe36KyYm2y-z9C57HBcGIlsw3nmE2VSDozr09R0jFEaOPdIodbzByBkQS_KhjiNfVOM5WXtZCtwqKePjfosTul6nxhEsJd9JDXC-OTI1y5n0jVMpAL5DuYduodvZCL0rneBxMeClK00vS8Za-cT5L4xEkRNPhz1rNKa5u1H-mLmvIwtcjdxE0AEIjbZ--Q9zOMN3zLlm5IEQTND13FDzeg_FlJeyDQHEDuEr0dOboBatXHvSSPnIYUfTTS3uy-r1bf-P5wd7cPTscCS_86T1Sy2oRTLV3cKd_3vlTcxOs265fJgXJWwPlXfHme-5puUI9HelKXcZm76bODcXhz5yaVWmRIwJTHw_sP_DMMARm4bob0sYQXs7ajsBxf8Ut-ZhPCnml2EehCPPM9sbtiVohK5SF1OZhhabFNS8Wss8mSdEENZFqLSsuT2mDEw3F650kQdetif5DzXCqx9z9QlZsT6swkGHZzi7DjB5ghEXpodRlvLiZld6dWVQcy8oOYQ%3D%3D)
---
We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
| [ ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=753d31b6e58e40da9f90d990be6d580f&_e=oe2iTmiwMOFmwtWrN2JJll8HhvoKWkMan9M-kA5NUMBIkL1BB-O-a9U4uZCayWemesLNOn1eKESKKkIjOPqXFf2Nm-Qo-x8Y6ZbYTZTHAMDicWQ7NIqOkWv_Zfad6mxwSly6JWQBO4f0a-uJYg2J_DxpYs8ruse5VANvsmZ-QAM0xfQfe72E-NuZ23HyJVvEslQq-B6eOzesgk0_PKFJbGvIe36KyYm2y-z9C57HBcGIlsw3nmE2VSDozr09R0jFmef5nEt_rA_3JLKUYBR_1wJ9dvT8sgRTe3ESDWU6G_HdMfoOSnb-oSk5HXAZtvUJ2y_Yh0uEtk5-uP031JrqB9of8fpAjKAR-2PiYPKpKUBqaR8Gozz83Se1etsA1BRqOgn-6MdG7XduFiTClr05lDS3ENDj2SXGN716nQpnk6oq0oMJI4JOIR_IIqdryOrre3WLYxEz0YDiM22iol0aaX8xra89mXcWMdYHsHhDULnZsSyg22dVl8-6TzUTcHASIXQc3R2kgbZL_h6lK0HmD_C9Ha5CHbhbAD1vgbRCoMpQQAf12AFIX7GTVQX0EHgvQjfulmFghH2gEzM6l1eqR-JEH3S51jiMaGPgZlffnrUx_62UMw4IuGQW_Md_vUQseqZr2tAJ0kb5Ea1mnRfOSREVUVqX08NZJUogmD-L0ANthDuyqG1rQ5gmt7mTrpizVYv7_33Hi8l_ctqX6y5n4Q%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**
| [ ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=753d31b6e58e40da9f90d990be6d580f&_e=oe2iTmiwMOFmwtWrN2JJll8HhvoKWkMan9M-kA5NUMBIkL1BB-O-a9U4uZCayWemesLNOn1eKESKKkIjOPqXFf2Nm-Qo-x8Y6ZbYTZTHAMDicWQ7NIqOkWv_Zfad6mxwSly6JWQBO4f0a-uJYg2J_DxpYs8ruse5VANvsmZ-QAM0xfQfe72E-NuZ23HyJVvEslQq-B6eOzesgk0_PKFJbGvIe36KyYm2y-z9C57HBcGIlsw3nmE2VSDozr09R0jFBfiX2-AGPecRWIQ7rBWJyyJsS7SUdYf2Dg84x5nOXqC6W-ILV6Hen2j6gkYTVCh51BWSAxw_8Ny40LXJL9Cf5k31CAjiOeB43HbPCeAgV7G4mlAaXQ5UFNY0ICp_5ioHOq8_TTkiiIe4RXrXjgJyu3jhMfl4B7_J0mtoqKc026mAXuO-hU8C-6pyEpcYLgL4Xxf0smDCdg96MHOl6K9xZKq_RxUVsdkzXMRghWIf97cFmGoiDGFLGJZDMDdruc7wAzcjK-PxYv9ttlowoBzNNAjx8dEixTB2Mr8Nlxh_eW6CMWVods-as1--TEfF8GD-rp2FerP-h1NkYNyaQ83t7c2je5663n489eUozOJgUmnPeF-taLCH7OLC00Te_yRVWU6hm4hCybK-2chZKm_Rz4y5RKEWcvA0BVZY-Mc4hDCLXQJdcJRxzb7AG6NBX1PsTlU7RuoN7MkK5XdxemwhLg%3D%3D)
---
**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**
Chief Operating Officer
