[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z241up3pjblvr6tv9u943h17nb3e7kgcnmtbukpg_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zfsdfrc4m4vjdp2mrc931b4dcusqnvlr4h719t38_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6ruh490ofvf6ado2c3rq71tj5e1brrl3o473790_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ztlttufqfbs0eivbruc8d9tc7ru21u6mkolbh98g_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs)
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z3ifnc4jatdat03v6aevclsjhhpgqntj5m7vtps0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zn4mif4c6lngu6pc75i5gvgj8smrvp0c2mpg6hr8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zq0hql8jbt9cml40agn8a4q6uq3n1o2i2klbc1vo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zoa5c1sp0sjl9bu496aeerbmlmcda1nr1jpsse0o_rp22sh2s8i6eor0clhm8p36cth2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

clean_body: | | | | | | For the first time in years, there is peace in Jerusalem—and today’s podcast couldn’t be more appropriate for this moment. I sit down with my good friend Luke Moon, the Executive Director of the Philos Project, which equips Christians to stand with Israel and the Jewish people, support persecuted Christians in the Middle East, and foster a revival of Western values rooted in the Hebraic origins of our faith. Luke and I have partnered on numerous occasions—in New York City, L.A., Pasadena, and during last year’s Columbia University antisemitism riots. At Columbia, we hoped 500 people would show up, but we were blown away when more than 5,000 joined us! Listen to this powerful conversation about Israel, America, the Middle East, and the vital role we as believers play in it all. 🎧 LISTEN ON ITUNES ⬇︎⬇︎⬇︎ 📱 WATCH ON YOUTUBE ⬇︎⬇︎⬇︎ | | My heart is to see the next generation of leaders stand strong and stand tall. In just 20 days, three Democratic justices will be up for reelection (or defeat) on the same ballot, and MAGA is competing to knock out all three at once.
Saving these three Dem justices would result in a resounding victory that will send shockwaves through MAGA World--effectively shutting down the momentum for "Trump 2028" they have worked so hard to build.

Across the country, families are struggling. Here in St. Louis, we feel it most of all. Rent and everyday expenses keep climbing. Our rights are being stripped away. And from floods to tornadoes to the ongoing crisis of state violence, our safety and health are constantly on the line.

This campaign is about protecting our communities and building a future where dignity, justice, and opportunity are for everyone.

Friend, it's Kat. I know your feed on social media is probably post after post about what's going on here in Chicago, and coming to your email to read about it again is probably one of the last things you want to do. So if you need a breather, I understand. There's a picture of Heater being cute at the end of this email. **But please remember that we are all in this together.** **We've seen** the rise of far-right nationalism before and how unaccountable and unidentifiable "law enforcement" officials silence political dissidents and hide their unjust cruelty against immigrants behind the excuse of "protecting their homeland." **We've seen** power-hungry politicians throw entire groups under the bus to advance their careers and remain in control. **And we've seen** how division is used to weaken real progressive movements and turn neighbors against each other. Friend, this affects all of us—we're all in the same boat, **and we can't let each other down.** If you'd like to stay organized, [**please join our Discord!**](https://ka4il.us/l/6CXX2q1r0sjX) Take care, and let's continue fighting back. Thanks, Kat Abughazaleh Friend, it's Kat Abughazaleh, and if this isn't a sign of what's to come, I don't know what is.

# Trump and Bessent stand up to China's predatory market manipulation
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced Wednesday that the Trump administration will impose price floors across key industries to **[shield U.S. firms from China's predatory dumping,](https://substack.com/redirect/8b7a2ff5-3dc4-47d8-aa8c-8f3c04c313ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** vowing to end two decades of market sabotage and bolster American economic defenses.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8b7a2ff5-3dc4-47d8-aa8c-8f3c04c313ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Bessent Unveils Anti-Dumping Strategy:** Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent revealed plans for "forward buying" mechanisms alongside price floors to preemptively counter Chinese undercutting in nascent U.S. processors and refiners.
**Bessent Draws A Line In The Sand:** _" If some in the Chinese government want to slow down the global economy through disappointing actions and through economic coercion, the Chinese economy will be hurt the most -- and make no mistake: this is China vs. the world."_
[](https://substack.com/redirect/543c20d9-0302-49b2-ba00-b2d6ce5c5131?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Two-Decade Dumping Pattern Exposed:** For 20 years, China has slashed prices to bankrupt competitors in market-based economies whenever new facilities emerge, a tactic Bessent highlighted as a deliberate tactic of economic warfare.
**Broad Industry Protections Planned:** The policy targets multiple sectors beyond critical minerals, aiming to foster resilient supply chains and prevent future business failures stemming from intentionally aggressive foreign pricing.
**Developing Policy Signals Escalation:** As a nascent initiative from the "Invest in America" forum, the measures underscore Trump's aggressive trade stance, with full implementation details forthcoming to reshape global competition.

# **Gold hits historic $4,235 an oz amid escalating trade war**

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4015636b-d35e-4a83-bbd8-210c14d68738?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

# Morgan Stanley and Bank of America's Q3 earnings shatter Wall Street records
A **[roaring Wall Street](https://substack.com/redirect/21e99a6e-85a8-4604-b6eb-c5e86cd32884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** fueled by merger mania and IPO fever propelled Bank of America and Morgan Stanley to blowout third-quarter profits Friday, with each netting over $1 billion above Wall Street forecasts amid soaring dealmaking fees and trading revenues.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/21e99a6e-85a8-4604-b6eb-c5e86cd32884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**[Bank of America](https://substack.com/redirect/22746f50-afd3-4f0b-b315-1c880ec3f7f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** shattered Wall Street forecasts Tuesday, posting third-quarter profits of $8.2 billion--a 15% jump from last year--fueled by roaring investment banking fees and steady consumer spending, as CEO Brian Moynihan hailed resilient U.S. economic momentum amid rate-cut hopes.
* **Investment Banking Fees Explode** : Fees rocketed 45% to $1.8 billion, driven by a M&A revival and debt underwriting boom, outpacing rivals like JPMorgan.
* **Net Interest Income Stabilizes** : Net Interest Income held firm at $14.1 billion despite Fed rate pauses, bolstered by 2% deposit growth to $1.9 trillion in key consumer segments.
* **Trading Revenues Climb Steadily** : Equities trading surged 12% to $4.2 billion on volatile markets, while fixed income dipped 3% but offset broader gains.
* **Credit Losses Remain Tame** : Provisions for bad loans edged up to $1.1 billion, signaling low consumer delinquency rates under 1%, with optimistic full-year guidance intact.

**[Morgan Stanley](https://substack.com/redirect/8516d045-b001-4e50-8e9a-da4e9c64d722?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** surged past Wall Street forecasts Wednesday with third-quarter profits climbing 43% to $3.06 billion, fueled by a blockbuster 57% leap in investment banking fees, as CEO Ted Pick heralds a "renaissance" in dealmaking amid cooling rates.
* **Investment Banking Fees Explode** : Revenues from advisory, underwriting soared 57% year-over-year to $1.45 billion, outpacing rivals amid revived M&A activity such as high-profile advisories like Union Pacific's $71 billion Norfolk Southern buyout.
* **Wealth Management Growth Steady** : Client assets hit record $7.1 trillion, with management fees up 8%, though equity trading dipped slightly due to market volatility.
* **Trading Revenues Mixed Bag** : Fixed-income trading jumped 14% on strong bond sales, but equities fell 4% from tough comparisons and subdued volumes.
* **Optimistic Full-Year Outlook** : CEO Pick eyes continued fee momentum into 2026, with cost controls targeting 2% expense growth despite regulatory pressures.

# Jamie Dimon's "Cockroach" comment about credit losses hide a bigger issue
JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon bluntly called a $170 million loss from a bankrupt subprime auto lender "not our finest moment" Tuesday, **[warning of potential hidden risks in commercial lending](https://substack.com/redirect/8a54feb4-85a5-41d6-b31f-47524f15b33e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Tricolor's fraud-tainted collapse, even as third-quarter profits soared 12%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3db607ea-eaaf-460f-a691-d8ef75541762?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tricolor Fraud Exposed Deeply** : Dallas-based subprime lender Tricolor Holdings filed for bankruptcy in early September amid allegations of auto loan fraud, ensnaring JPMorgan in a $170 million wholesale lending write-off.
* **Charge-Offs Surge Dramatically** : Bank's net charge-offs climbed 8% to $2.6 billion in Q3, largely from commercial and investment banking hikes, though Tricolor hit remains immaterial to overall earnings.
* **Cockroach Risks Loom Large** : Dimon invoked "one cockroach means more" metaphor, signaling heightened scrutiny of lending portfolio for systemic weaknesses beyond isolated failures.
* **Peers Share Subprime Pain** : Fifth Third and Barclays also face Tricolor losses as creditors, spotlighting Wall Street's broader exposure to weakening commercial credit amid rising bankruptcies like First Brands and the Jefferies debacle.

# DOJ just seized $15B in Bitcoin from a "pig butchering" scam in Cambodia
In a landmark crackdown on global fraud, the U.S. Department of Justice **[seized a record $15 billion in Bitcoin](https://substack.com/redirect/3e343c69-1c80-447c-8e8f-2c93ab0b527a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tuesday from a Cambodia-based "pig butchering" scam empire, indicting fugitive tycoon Chen Zhi for orchestrating forced-labor compounds that bilked victims worldwide out of billions through deceptive crypto investments.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3e343c69-1c80-447c-8e8f-2c93ab0b527a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Forfeiture Sets Record** : DOJ's $15 billion bitcoin haul marks the largest asset seizure in its history, targeting holdings from Chen Zhi's Prince Holding Group conglomerate.
* **Forced Labor Fuels Fraud** : Victims were coerced by scam operators in Cambodian compounds, where trafficked individuals executed "pig butchering" schemes preying on global targets via fake investment lures.
* **Indictment Unsealed Swiftly** : Federal charges against Chen, alias "Vincent," dropped in Brooklyn court Tuesday, alleging he founded and chaired the operation while evading capture abroad.
* **Global Scam Implications Loom** : The billions stolen underscore rising crypto fraud threats, prompting U.S. authorities to intensify international probes into human-trafficking-tied schemes.

name: The Flyover
subject: How It All Started
body:
>From 47 readers to 3 million -- here's the kitchen-table moment that sparked _The Flyover_.
###

| | |
---
| |
#
---
**Dear Reader,** Just over two years ago, I was sitting at my kitchen table with a yellow notepad, a half-empty cup of coffee, and the news on TV in the background.

I looked up, and it was just another shouting match. Another "breaking" story that broke nothing but trust. I remember saying out loud to myself, **"Where do people like us go for real news anymore?"** That was the spark. I'd spent my career in politics, business, and dealing with the media. I'd seen firsthand how the national conversation was being shaped -- and warped -- by a handful of loud voices on the coasts and by celebrity "journalists" more interested in pushing their agendas than reporting the actual news. The rest of America, what many refer to as "flyover country," had been forgotten. So, I decided to talk to a few friends, business associates, and a few folks who still believed facts mattered, and we launched a daily email publication -- _The Flyover_.

We didn't have fancy investors. We had a small group of believers, hard workers, and a vision: _Common Sense News for Common Sense Americans._ **We distributed our first news publication to 47 people. **Just friends and family. That was April 15th, 2023. Today, _The Flyover_ reaches over **3 million readers across the country** every single day. For context, CNN reaches about 500,000 viewers in prime time. Fox News reaches about 3 million. We've launched 9 state editions -- from Arizona to Tennessee to Virginia -- plus our national edition and our _Feel Good Flyover_ Friday publication.

We publish 61 unique editions each week and produce _The Flyover_ _Podcast_ seven days a week -- hosted by real people committed to getting stories right and serving the needs of common sense news consumers. And we did it all while achieving profitability, which is something that almost no other media startup can say.

Our margins are strong (80% gross, 24% net). Our readership is growing faster than we can keep up with. And our brand is being built the right way -- by earning trust, not chasing clicks. We've grown because of you.

Every new edition, every new hire, every podcast episode -- all of it has been built because readers like you opened our emails, read and shared them, and said, "Finally, someone's telling it straight." **Truth Takes Flight and[Readers Take Ownership](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskc1uqzAQhZ_G7BL5B0NYeHF1uexys6nUJTJ4CFMZO7KHoLx9RZt21WW355v5pKPzeu7PFj2G63-7gKEp9g4cjpbA9QG27IEIUj_HDcl6n8mmHUku9UHwg9D9325avW-_v-rCmQlAgirAiLriWgtV6WI2tuGqadQAUzlOoxukPAlV10prO9STHQs0u1dwocWJy7I8WtXIUulSSj5w4SwrOTikmI5vEQPNMPlHvEM6jnEpvJmJbpmpP0x2THYY7pDph8sdq26lpc9xTSMw1f5zSBgDk9UeL-BwXZhqL1sAdziDQ_tEo11uFq-Bqbb7NH6BGAgCMdXOmCmmxzMnSLvppbu0_d5M6iIZd9vQe8xVzUp-XSz6jwb0SwPcjXwPAAD__7cwn5g)

**When we launched our reader-ownership campaign in August, I didn't know what to expect. What happened next stunned us.

In just over two months, more than 1,450 Flyover readers became owners -- investing almost $2.5 million to help us grow. We are already halfway to our $5 million goal.

"FIGHT BACK" The Center is fighting back against this coordinated attack on your health care. But we need your help. name: Mark Kelly
subject: I didn’t plan on this
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
#

Team, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be called a traitor by the richest guy in the world, or to have one of Trump’s advisors calling for my execution.
Now, I don’t want you to worry about me. And after everything I’ve been through, things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that they will intimidate others, though — people just beginning to get involved. People thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a local town hall. I worry that Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him, and that it might be working.
But then I look back at this team. You’ve been with me a long time, and you haven’t backed down. Your support means the world to me, but it also gives me a lot of hope that enough people will stand up, push back, and make sure these guys don’t stay in power.
I’m ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:

Here's what you need to know about next month's elections:

**📍 What's at stake: **
* **Key governorships** in New Jersey and Virginia, where we have an opportunity to hold a blue seat and flip a red one.
* **State legislatures** that have stood as the last line of defense, like in Virginia, where we've endorsed 10 women running for the state House.
* A **State Supreme Court seat** in Pennsylvania, where key rulings on abortion access and voting rights have been decided, and we've endorsed Justice Christine Donohue.

**🎯 What to watch for:**
* **Flip opportunities are real** — and razor-thin. In Virginia, Democrats currently control both chambers by the slimmest of margins. Republicans need to pick up just a few seats to flip control.
* **Close races could be decided by just a few hundred votes** — which means we can't afford to leave a single voter on the sidelines.

**🚨 Why it matters:**
* Under the Trump administration, we've seen how much power states hold in protecting or dismantling our fundamental freedoms. **Democratic governors and state legislatures have shielded millions from national rollbacks on our rights.**
* The outcomes of these elections **_will_ set the stage for 2026**. The results of these races will determine who has the upper-hand going into the midterm elections

Less than three weeks from now, voters will head to the polls to cast their ballots in monumental governor, state legislature, and state Supreme Court races. EMILYs List has endorsed Democratic women running in all of these races, and our victories would put the writing on the wall for Republicans and show them that women are not just running this cycle, they're winning. = | = Here's what you need to know about next month's elections: 📍 What's at stake: Key governorships in New Jersey and Virginia, where we have an opportunity to hold a blue seat and flip a red one. State legislatures that have stood as the last line of defense, like in Virginia, where we've endorsed 10 women running for the state House. A State Supreme Court seat in Pennsylvania, where key rulings on abortion access and voting rights have been decided, and we've endorsed Justice Christine Donohue. 🎯 What to watch for: Flip opportunities are real — and razor-thin. In Virginia, Democrats currently control both chambers by the slimmest of margins. Republicans need to pick up just a few seats to flip control. Close races could be decided by just a few hundred votes — which means we can't afford to leave a single voter on the sidelines. 🚨 Why it matters: Under the Trump administration, we've seen how much power states hold in protecting or dismantling our fundamental freedoms. Please - for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.

| |

| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please - for the sake of all our families - take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children. You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue 's Clues_...
---
[](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyckc2KIjEURp8mtYvkP3FRi7ZLZUCHwYUyq5Cfqx06VZFULOm3HxymX2C2B86Fc7_L0R5dymm6_XQj9CE_bZ1te9TJjVBTcN6Fz1ZuJeavxWXLCJOYEkylvdcy3yE0K7vYS8NgrTroqVZESqW56D76yEgw3vPIvTZCX4kCFSkEuV5LE666S_3rICVUUiMkFStvnBZEKCoc4VEQJIjLUNsqlGmGuriWFsjJQ21fz1RhFcrY5f6jtfuM-BtiO8R2M4RHhZWbIJaXOSK289UtgH0pnzNiO6apZIEZHCUoLLwQ2FBlMEivlQJ9NWuK-O7RRjuXRw2A-LAZ9vi0PSOmXniEmB4j4sP2-I8EN95duk2ID68oIiixm2FvN6e389b-2O9_M3mwp-3Z_nrD74fLt1amBlNDfHg_XPD3O7rax_sz5ZxmpZEgt9Gl_De2_e9IS8_-BAAA__-gyJyR)

clean_body: Please - for the sake of all our families | | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children. | | | | Dear Friend in Faith, Please - for the sake of all our families - take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children. You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on Blue 's Clues... | | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses. And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas. Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. Introducing: Iggy and Mr. Kirk. I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at Brave Books. If you've seen me and Brave Books on Fox News , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own. And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries. It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television. > Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. >> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can't beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a Founding Supporter. The great news is that we've already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of Iggy and Mr. Kirk! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces. And I wish you could have experienced the parents watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages. It was quite a moment for everyone - including folks just like you - who worked so hard to get us that far. But now Brave Books has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with. #1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left. You see, we've made the first five episodes of Season 1 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk available absolutely FREE. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging. But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the Left will try to bury Iggy and Mr. Kirk at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 - and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately. #2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production. I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. As our special "Thank You" for becoming a Founding Supporter at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of Iggy and Mr. Kirk FREE on DVD. This exclusive Iggy and Mr. Kirk DVD is only offered to Founding Supporters. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with , you'll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes. And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family - not filth. Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a Founding Supporter of Iggy and Mr. Kirk. subject: St. Louis shouldn't have to pay for the GOP's petty politics
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
Peter,

**Right now, Missouri is paying the price for Washington's dysfunction.**

body:
Two former board presidents urge a course correction for Cherry Creek schools
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/serd9728545)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s7lc5478e37)**
| | Hi friends,
Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sbm0e3ca4f9), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/scqf7f5a33f) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s0v9ca25e2d)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Mayor Mike Johnston’s [$1 billion Vibrant Denver bond](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s7te87dd67d) is under an ethics complaint for allegedly using taxpayer-funded groups like the Denver Zoo and Botanic Gardens to back the campaign. The state Supreme Court ruled that pre-2025 laws [didn’t cover AI-generated child pornography](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s2h076ce730), exposing a legislative gap. Aurora police arrested four suspects [tied to a gang investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s8hfff5aff3), while Littleton mayoral candidate Patrick Driscoll was caught on camera [removing an opponent’s campaign flyer](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s1v7631884e), stirring accusations of unethical conduct.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** A new poll shows [most voters support President Trump’s decision](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s0m0632a52c) to deploy the National Guard to protect federal sites, even after a temporary court block. At the same time, his administration [laid off more than 400 HUD staffers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s4l4bed8b99) as part of a restructuring to end Obama-era zoning rules critics say threatened suburban autonomy and to refocus the agency on its core housing mission.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** The _Denver Gazette_ _editorial board_ warns that Colorado’s roads are increasingly [deadly due to high-potency marijuana](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s3ofc39d7a7), urging lawmakers to act before federal rescheduling worsens the issue. On the Western Slope, Greg Walcher accuses Denver Water of abandoning promises [to protect Shoshone water rights](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sav55b6ba48), risking rural communities. [And in Cherry Creek](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sbv60505a0b), former school board presidents Jennifer Churchfield and Aagje Barber call for reform-minded leadership to reverse declining scores and fiscal mismanagement.
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 15, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Two former board presidents urge a course correction for Cherry Creek schools](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sck783f72ae)** BY JENNIFER CHURCHFIELD & AAGJE BARBER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s5h53648611)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s1j5f54e4bd)
_As former presidents of the Cherry Creek School Board, we have always believed that the success of our schools begins with a laser focus on students, academic excellence, and responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars. Today, we write with deep concern — and urgency — about the direction of the district and the need for a course correction. That’s why we are endorsing Amanda Thayer and Tatyana Sturm for the Cherry Creek School Board._
_The Board of Education has taken its eye off the classroom. As a result, fewer than half of Cherry Creek students are proficient at grade level in core subjects — a staggering statistic for a district once considered a statewide leader in academic performance. This is unacceptable. (Source: Denver Post, Aug. 21, 2025)_
_While nearby districts like Boulder Valley have earned the state’s top accreditation rating, and Douglas County is rapidly improving student outcomes, Cherry Creek continues to lag behind. We have not returned to pre-COVID achievement levels — and in some areas, we are falling further behind._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s0h348419f5)**
|
---
**[Voters face a $56 million question: Should “free lunch for all” come from your refund?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s6ma57314a7)** BY NASH HERMAN & JAKE FOGLEMAN, [INDEPENDENCE INSTITUTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sas4d8c2f3f)
* Colorado’s universal Healthy School Meals for All program, created under Proposition FF, has run a $56 million shortfall in its first year, far exceeding cost projections.
* Proposition LL would allow the state to permanently retain excess revenue from the program—bypassing TABOR refund limits—while Proposition MM would further raise income taxes on households earning over $300,000 and divert some funds to SNAP.
* Analysts warn both measures lack inflation indexing, meaning more Coloradans will be taxed each year as wages rise, and argue rejecting them would preserve free lunches for low-income students while restoring fiscal sustainability.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sfg2870a131)**

**[West Slope’s Conscience v. Denver’s Memory](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sdnabf8c955)** BY GREG WALCHER, [GREGWALCHER.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sat2d4271f9)
* Greg Walcher warns that Front Range water utilities, including Denver Water, are backtracking on a decade-old agreement to support the Colorado River District’s purchase of the historic Shoshone water rights from Xcel Energy, valued near $100 million.
* The dispute centers on whether the Colorado Water Conservation Board or the River District should control enforcement of the “Shoshone call,” with Front Range objections threatening to derail the deal.
* Walcher argues the reversal betrays Western Slope communities that depend on Shoshone’s senior water rights for protection against further transmountain diversions, calling Denver’s stance a “convenient memory lapse” of its 2013 commitments.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s1r3015cab7)**

**[At Mesa County rally, Anthony Watson challenges crowd to trade outrage for obedience](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s4ge65b4c88)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 13** No bulls, no broncs—the arena lights belonged to a different crowd. Sun broke in strips across a clouded sky after a full day of rain. Over 500 filled the grandstands for a different kind of roundup with local pastors, community leaders and a two-time Olympian. Bookcliff led off with the Star-Spangled Banner and closed beneath candlelight with God Bless America.
**[The sword is passed: Honoring Charlie Kirk’s bold stand for truth](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/s2jd6fe077e)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 12** _As we conclude this series on The Sword of the Spirit, my heart feels both heavy and hopeful. Heavy, because we mourn the loss of a strong, confident voice for truth and a dear friend of Rocky Mountain Voice—Charlie Kirk. Hopeful, because his legacy shows us the trail we are called to follow, with no exceptions, and in my opinion, there is no better way to close this powerful series._
**[School unions gave $11K to Jeffco candidate who admitted to a sealed juvenile sexual offense](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._vWw/sfr0bf56900)**
**BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 10** When the Jefferson County Education Association endorsed Michael Yocum for school board this fall, few voters—perhaps not even the union itself—knew the full story. According to verified audio recordings obtained by Rocky Mountain Voice (RMV), Yocum privately acknowledged a deferred adjudication involving a sealed juvenile sexual offense. Yocum received thousands in funding and endorsements from education-aligned groups.

That’s why we are endorsing Amanda Thayer and Tatyana Sturm for the Cherry Creek School Board. The Board of Education has taken its eye off the classroom. As a result, fewer than half of Cherry Creek students are proficient at grade level in core subjects — a staggering statistic for a district once considered a statewide leader in academic performance. This is unacceptable. (Source: Denver Post, Aug. 21, 2025) While nearby districts like Boulder Valley have earned the state’s top accreditation rating, and Douglas County is rapidly improving student outcomes, Cherry Creek continues to lag behind. We have not returned to pre-COVID achievement levels — and in some areas, we are falling further behind. | BY NASH HERMAN & JAKE FOGLEMAN, Colorado’s universal Healthy School Meals for All program, created under Proposition FF, has run a $56 million shortfall in its first year, far exceeding cost projections. Proposition LL would allow the state to permanently retain excess revenue from the program—bypassing TABOR refund limits—while Proposition MM would further raise income taxes on households earning over $300,000 and divert some funds to SNAP. Analysts warn both measures lack inflation indexing, meaning more Coloradans will be taxed each year as wages rise, and argue rejecting them would preserve free lunches for low-income students while restoring fiscal sustainability. | The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support! | BY GREG WALCHER, Greg Walcher warns that Front Range water utilities, including Denver Water, are backtracking on a decade-old agreement to support the Colorado River District’s purchase of the historic Shoshone water rights from Xcel Energy, valued near $100 million. The dispute centers on whether the Colorado Water Conservation Board or the River District should control enforcement of the “Shoshone call,” with Front Range objections threatening to derail the deal. Walcher argues the reversal betrays Western Slope communities that depend on Shoshone’s senior water rights for protection against further transmountain diversions, calling Denver’s stance a “convenient memory lapse” of its 2013 commitments. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 13 No bulls, no broncs—the arena lights belonged to a different crowd. Sun broke in strips across a clouded sky after a full day of rain. Over 500 filled the grandstands for a different kind of roundup with local pastors, community leaders and a two-time Olympian. Bookcliff led off with the Star-Spangled Banner and closed beneath candlelight with God Bless America. BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 12 As we conclude this series on The Sword of the Spirit, my heart feels both heavy and hopeful. Heavy, because we mourn the loss of a strong, confident voice for truth and a dear friend of Rocky Mountain Voice—Charlie Kirk. Hopeful, because his legacy shows us the trail we are called to follow, with no exceptions, and in my opinion, there is no better way to close this powerful series. BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 10 When the Jefferson County Education Association endorsed Michael Yocum for school board this fall, few voters—perhaps not even the union itself—knew the full story. According to verified audio recordings obtained by Rocky Mountain Voice (RMV), Yocum privately acknowledged a deferred adjudication involving a sealed juvenile sexual offense. Yocum received thousands in funding and endorsements from education-aligned groups. Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share? CBS NEWS: Illegal crossings along U.S.-Mexico border plummet to lowest annual level since 1970 |
---

Thank you, President Trump!

Americans voted for safe streets and a secure border, and with President Trump back in the White House, they are getting exactly that, Fellow Conservative.

**CBS NEWS: Illegal crossings along U.S.-Mexico border plummet to lowest annual level since 1970**

As a Navy SEAL, I've served overseas and seen firsthand what happens when you have a porous border.

The violent, illegal alien thugs who Joe Biden let invade our country and terrorize our communities for four years have been put on notice. Fellow Conservative, we are safer thanks to President Trump.

But Democrats are doing whatever they can to undo our victories in the Senate. Liberal cities are protesting and blocking ICE agents from doing their jobs.

It’s been 15 days since Donald Trump sent National Guard troops to our city.
They’re trying to make an example of Portland to enforce their anti-immigrant agenda. They want to paint us as a lawless city that must be militarized, and they want to provoke us.

We believe in peace, community, and democracy.
We know who we are.
Together, we will resist this madman and his authoritarian stunts by speaking truth to power, by protesting as is our right, and by fighting back in the courts and the House.
We will not be silenced.

name: Scott P. Brown
subject: It’s not always easy.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Brown for New Hampshire, Inc
body:
Nothing in my life has ever been handed to me.
I aspired to be a good husband and a good dad — the American Dream.
| | Fellow Patriot, It often comes as a surprise to people I meet on the campaign trail that I didn’t grow up with aspirations of becoming an Ambassador or U.S. Senator growing up. **_I aspired to be a good husband, and a good dad. I aspired to have a happy family life and live the American Dream._** I had a challenging upbringing. My mom was married and divorced 4 times, and my dad was married and divorced 3 times. My dad was not always there to help guide me and all my stepfathers told me that I would never amount to anything.
---

It’s fair to say they were not support systems. But I really wouldn't change a thing. Those early struggles taught me grit, resilience, and the value of hard work. **_Nothing was ever handed to me._** I worked my way through college and law school, and at 19 I joined the Army National Guard, where I served proudly for nearly 40 years before retiring as a Colonel.

clean_body: Nothing in my life has ever been handed to me. I aspired to be a good husband and a good dad — the American Dream. | | Fellow Patriot, It often comes as a surprise to people I meet on the campaign trail that I didn’t grow up with aspirations of becoming an Ambassador or U.S. Senator growing up. I aspired to be a good husband, and a good dad. I aspired to have a happy family life and live the American Dream. I had a challenging upbringing. My mom was married and divorced 4 times, and my dad was married and divorced 3 times. My dad was not always there to help guide me and all my stepfathers told me that I would never amount to anything. It’s fair to say they were not support systems. But I really wouldn't change a thing. Those early struggles taught me grit, resilience, and the value of hard work. Nothing was ever handed to me. I worked my way through college and law school, and at 19 I joined the Army National Guard, where I served proudly for nearly 40 years before retiring as a Colonel. In 2010, I took a leap of faith and ran for U.S. Senate. With grassroots supporters like you and a lot of miles on my old GMC truck, we shocked the political world with a historic upset. I was the guy that STOPPED the Democrats’ supermajority in the Senate. In Washington, I refused to play insider games—and that made me a target. Democrats poured millions into defeating me, and eventually, they did. But I never stopped serving. I became a grandfather, poured myself into my New Hampshire community, and later represented America as U.S. Ambassador to New Zealand and Samoa. If we’ve learned anything over the last few years, it’s this: when Democrats are in control, things fall apart FAST. > >Inflation spikes, our borders are left WIDE OPEN to criminals and terrorists, our standing on the world stage weakens, and hardworking families are left behind. >> That’s why I’m stepping back into the fight — because we must keep the Senate in Republican hands, and we must keep electing strong, conservative leaders who will stand up for American values. I know the value of a dollar, and how hard you and I have worked every day of our lives to create prosperity for ourselves and our families , so I wouldn’t be asking you today if your URGENT donation did not make a BIG difference in flipping this Senate seat. The New Hampshire Senate race could tip control of the entire U.S. Senate and finally halt the “lawfare” targeting President Trump, his team, and YOUR freedoms. If we win in New Hampshire, we can stop the Left’s agenda in its tracks. If we lose... they’ll have free rein for years to come. Every patriot’s support is critical. If we win, we keep President Trump’s majority. If we lose, the Democrats will seize the Senate and launch a relentless campaign to cripple his presidency – political lawfare, sham investigations, and a total blockade on his policies. We have no time to waste if we’re going to show the Radical Left they don’t stand a CHANCE of flipping the Senate majority. I understand money can be tight these days, Fellow Patriot. That’s why I would not ask if it was not absolutely necessary to raise early funds NOW in order to win this seat. Your support means the world to me, and I’m so grateful. If you’re unable to give at this time, I understand. But if you can spare any amount, now is the time to do so. Thank you for your time, for reading my story, and for joining this fight for the future of America. Scott P. | | Hi Friend, In California, we’ve always led with values of fairness, justice, and democracy that include everyone. Proposition 50, on the ballot this November, is how we defend that promise. Across the country, we’re watching states like Texas and Ohio redraw congressional maps mid-decade to silence voters and lock in minority rule. Proposition 50 is California’s safeguard against that kind of election-rigging. If passed, it would **temporarily update California’s congressional maps through 2030** to ensure our representation remains fair, unlike other states that manipulate theirs. Then, in 2031, control returns to our independent redistricting commission. This measure isn’t about partisanship. It’s about protection. It’s about ensuring our communities aren’t erased, our votes aren’t diluted, and our democracy isn’t undermined by those willing to bend the rules to maintain power. When red states rig their maps, California must respond, not with the same tactics, but with a plan grounded in fairness and accountability. That’s what the Election Rigging Response Act does. It’s a **temporary safeguard to protect representation** , here and across the nation. As someone who’s spent my life fighting to make systems work for everyone, I see Prop 50 for what it is: a chance to protect the democratic foundation generations before us fought to build. | [Vote Yes on 50!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117343778/576163643/-517765028?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmU3MGVjZDYtZmZhOS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=d_AI7RHMNI6iS3ryI13KE2ubeADfJCfFf2vF8P1ZRyU=&emci=492d5d18-30a9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=be70ecd6-ffa9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=22554739)

Raul Ruiz

**President Donald J. Trump Endorses Congressman Russell Fry for Re-Election** **MYRTLE BEACH, S.C.** – President Donald J. Trump has officially endorsed Congressman Russell Fry for re-election to represent South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District for a third term. **President Trump released the following[statement](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=06c72361b8&e=7aa6ac5965):** _“Congressman Russell Fry is an America First Patriot, who is doing an incredible job representing South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District! A MAGA Warrior, who has been with us from the very beginning, Russell is working hard to Grow our Economy, Cut Taxes and Regulations, Advance American Energy DOMINANCE, Promote MADE IN THE U.S.A., Keep our now very Secure Border, SECURE, Support our Great Military/Veterans, and Protect our always under siege Second Amendment. Russell Fry has my Complete and Total Endorsement for Re-Election — HE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN!”_ **Congressman Fry expressed his gratitude for the continued support of President Trump:** _“There is no stronger endorsement in politics than President Trump’s. He has led the charge for the America First movement — and I’ve been proud to fight alongside him to secure our border, cut taxes, support domestic energy production, back the men and women in blue, and stand up to the chaos in Washington. Together, we will not back down. We’re fighting for South Carolina, for conservative values, and for the future of this country. I thank President Trump for his unwavering support.”_ Congressman Fry, first elected to Congress in 2022 with President Trump’s backing, has built a record of conservative leadership focused on fiscal responsibility, public safety, and defending South Carolina values. He currently serves on the House Judiciary and House Energy and Commerce Committees, where he has worked to hold the Biden Administration accountable, fight back against government overreach, and grow the American energy industry. For more information, visit [www.RussellFrySC.com](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=227b25ae3e&e=7aa6ac5965). ###

clean_body: Trump and his buddies don’t care if our children go hungry. | Let’s call this what it is, Peter: this is a Republican government shutdown. Trump’s administration has already set their wildly-unpopular plans in motion: They slashed Medicaid to the tune of almost a trillion dollars. And they’re hell-bent on letting Obamacare funding expire, so folks’ premiums will skyrocket — all to give their billionaire buddies a tax break. And now, they’ve ushered in a cruel and catastrophic government shutdown — all because they refused to negotiate with Democrats. Republicans don’t care that their actions could cause Americans everywhere to suffer: Mothers and children who rely on the WIC food program could lose the resources that keep them from going hungry. The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP, formerly known as food stamps) could also run out of funds — and plunge people everywhere into food insecurity. Tens of thousands of federal sector workers and active-duty members of the military will be forced to go in and do their jobs without pay. Democrats’ attempts to negotiate with Republicans over a way to keep the government funded and preserve access to health care for 20 million Americans were met with stonewalling, selfish tantrums, and partisan blame games. Peter, the cruelty is the point. Republican inaction caused this shutdown, and everything that may happen because of it. Democrats need to know RIGHT NOW if you stand with them against Republicans’ refusal to negotiate — and their willingness to let our kids go hungry. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117345740/576170061/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWU1NzQ3NC0wNGFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ml-3pqOjOH68ARDfvwwmyokBYegceuhodwj6RHLZWvQ=&emci=adf24e71-dca9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=19e57474-04aa-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=15820338)

Peter,

I know this shutdown is hurting so many of us here in Washington and nationwide, particularly the federal workers and their families who have already suffered under this administration.

I've met with people who depend on and work at Head Start, WIC, and food banks. I’ve met with TSA agents who are currently working without pay. I’ve heard from so many of you over the past couple of weeks, and I want you to know that I see you, I'm listening, and I'm fighting for you every single day in Congress. _There's something else I want you to know, too: healthcare is worth fighting for._

Republicans knew this deadline was coming, yet they refused to sit down and negotiate with Democrats.

They went it alone and expected that we’d just rubber-stamp their plans. They let government funding come to a halt, and since September 19, haven’t even shown up to work. Let’s be clear: they control the White House, the Senate, and the House, and they have known all along what it would take to get our support. **But they chose to turn their backs on us and the American people.**

I think we can all agree that this is far from what real leadership looks like, and it's certainly not what you deserve.

Peter, from our latest survey, I've heard your concerns:
* How long will this shutdown last?
* Will we be able to afford our health insurance premiums and have access to healthcare?
* How will we manage **rising household costs** and **strained finances** at a time when everything is already too expensive?

Recently, Republicans pushed through a big, ugly bill that slashed Medicaid for millions of Americans. And so many of you have written to me— _heartbroken, scared, angry_ —about what these cuts mean for your families.

We're already seeing the consequences play out. Rural hospitals are closing their doors because they know critical funding won't be there to keep doctors, nurses, and critical care staff on the job. Urban hospitals are laying off staff. Community clinics are cutting hours and laying off staff. Seniors are skipping medications because they can't afford refills. Patients are trying to get in for medical visits before they lose their health insurance.

In the midst of all of this, President Trump and Congressional Republicans shut down the government because they refused to prevent skyrocketing healthcare premiums for families. I want you to know that I’m fighting to end this shutdown and protect access to affordable healthcare.

Thank you for continuing to speak up, for sharing your stories, and for holding us accountable. Please know that I'll keep fighting for your families, your healthcare, and your future.

In solidarity,

Kim Rep. Kim Schrier is a doctor, scientist, and mom, fighting for Washington's 8th District in Congress. This is one of the most competitive districts in the country, so we need your help to keep Kim in Congress. But they chose to turn their backs on us and the American people. I think we can all agree that this is far from what real leadership looks like, and it's certainly not what you deserve. Peter, from our latest survey, I've heard your concerns: How long will this shutdown last? Will we be able to afford our health insurance premiums and have access to healthcare? How will we manage rising household costs and strained finances at a time when everything is already too expensive? Recently, Republicans pushed through a big, ugly bill that slashed Medicaid for millions of Americans. And so many of you have written to me— heartbroken, scared, angry —about what these cuts mean for your families. We're already seeing the consequences play out. Rural hospitals are closing their doors because they know critical funding won't be there to keep doctors, nurses, and critical care staff on the job. Urban hospitals are laying off staff. Community clinics are cutting hours and laying off staff. Seniors are skipping medications because they can't afford refills. Patients are trying to get in for medical visits before they lose their health insurance. In the midst of all of this, President Trump and Congressional Republicans shut down the government because they refused to prevent skyrocketing healthcare premiums for families. I want you to know that I’m fighting to end this shutdown and protect access to affordable healthcare. Thank you for continuing to speak up, for sharing your stories, and for holding us accountable. Please know that I'll keep fighting for your families, your healthcare, and your future. In solidarity, Kim Rep. Kim Schrier is a doctor, scientist, and mom, fighting for Washington's 8th District in Congress. This is one of the most competitive districts in the country, so we need your help to keep Kim in Congress. ---

Peter, The court ordered the Republican-led legislature in Utah to throw out a gerrymandered map and draw up a new, fair one. But instead, the GOP passed another gerrymander. And in case the courts don’t like this new map, they have a backup plan — Republican lawmakers passed a new, outrageous scheme to rig the redistricting process in order to tighten their stranglehold on power. You have to read it to believe it: This scheme would implement a test that experts have known for years doesn’t work for states with few districts and one-sided statewide elections. Applying that test where it shouldn’t be done is so well known that scholars nationwide call it the “Utah Paradox,” because Utah votes overwhelmingly Republican in most statewide elections. This is a not-so-subtle way for Republicans to have a monopoly over all of Utah’s congressional seats. **That’s not how math is supposed to work. And that’s certainly not how district maps work.** Communities should be represented fairly. Rural communities, urban communities, and Black and Brown communities must all be able to elect leaders who represent their needs and interests. **This is just the latest example of the shocking, audacious lengths Republicans will go to in order to steal congressional seats. They desperately don’t want to face the American people in a free and fair election. That’s tough, because the NDRC is prepared to fight back to ensure the will of the people can’t be ignored.** [**But with fights emerging in several states, it takes resources to mount a competitive opposition. This isn’t the first time the Utah legislature has tried to usurp the will of the people. In 2018, Utahns passed a ballot measure to create an independent redistricting commission and end gerrymandering. Then, the GOP legislature turned right around and repealed that ballot measure — drawing a gerrymandered map instead.
The fair maps movement mobilized and challenged that illegal map — and a judge threw it out this summer. But Trump’s pressure campaign to see as many districts gerrymandered as possible has spread to Utah. They’re bending to the White House and trying to push a new map that gives the GOP control of all four of Utah’s congressional districts.

clean_body: | Peter, The court ordered the Republican-led legislature in Utah to throw out a gerrymandered map and draw up a new, fair one. But instead, the GOP passed another gerrymander. And in case the courts don’t like this new map, they have a backup plan — Republican lawmakers passed a new, outrageous scheme to rig the redistricting process in order to tighten their stranglehold on power. You have to read it to believe it: This scheme would implement a test that experts have known for years doesn’t work for states with few districts and one-sided statewide elections. Applying that test where it shouldn’t be done is so well known that scholars nationwide call it the “Utah Paradox,” because Utah votes overwhelmingly Republican in most statewide elections. This is a not-so-subtle way for Republicans to have a monopoly over all of Utah’s congressional seats. That’s not how math is supposed to work. And that’s certainly not how district maps work. Communities should be represented fairly. Rural communities, urban communities, and Black and Brown communities must all be able to elect leaders who represent their needs and interests. This is just the latest example of the shocking, audacious lengths Republicans will go to in order to steal congressional seats. They desperately don’t want to face the American people in a free and fair election. Jason Crow For Colorado [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/Screenshot%202025-08-21%20at%2010.50.41%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Running for Congress wasn’t an easy decision, team.

I came from working class roots. I lived a life of service to our country — from enlisting in the National Guard to serving active duty in the Army after September 11th in Iraq and Afghanistan. I never imagined running for Congress.

But I have always gone where the fight is — and in 2017, the most important fight was right here in Colorado. Just a few months into his first term as president, Donald Trump tried to rip away health care, and rammed through tax breaks for the wealthy and his big donors. Does any of that sound familiar?

And in the middle of all that, our representative refused to stand up. Coloradans deserved better leadership. So I launched my campaign on April 11, 2017. Together, we flipped a red seat blue for the first time in decades.

They say history repeats itself, and here we are: Donald Trump is president once again.

He acts like a king and believes he’s above the law. He uses his presidency to enrich himself and his ultra-wealthy allies. And he’s doing it all on the backs of working people.

Like I said, I’ve never been one to back down from a tough fight.

What we’re seeing right now is not real leadership. I’m ready to fight harder than ever to deliver leadership that serves and listens, and I will work toward a better future for us all. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T672f26d4-e57e-4018-9703-c22d258907e5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| Peter, I often think about something my grandmother used to tell me: “No te dejes.” Don’t let them push you around. Fight back. That lesson has guided me my entire life, from the Rio Grande Valley to the state legislature — and it’s why today, I’m announcing that I’m running for Governor of Texas. Because right now, Texans are in the fight of our lives for our kids, our schools, and our future. And Greg Abbott has chosen a side: the billionaires, the special interests, the big corporations, and the wealthiest donors who bankroll him. Abbott has given away nearly a billion taxpayer dollars in contracts to his campaign donors and is still scheming to rip funding away from our neighborhood schools to give to private interests. That’s corruption, plain and simple — and it’s time we fight back. If you’re ready to take our state back from Abbott and his billionaire donors, I’m asking you to be one of the first to step up: [Peter, will you become a Founding Donor to my campaign by splitting a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action right now? With your support, we can prove we’re ready for this fight.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6f886aeb-927f-49ca-a72a-4815a17fea7a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| I grew up in Brownsville public schools — schools where no one had much, but we had each other. My parents were legal-aid lawyers representing farmworkers and families who had nowhere else to turn. My mom was born in Mexico; my dad was the first in his family to go to college. We lived in Mission, Texas. We moved so my dad could go to Georgetown Law. My mom worked to help put my dad through school. My mom eventually decided to go to law school herself. Then, our family came home to South Texas so my parents could fight for people like the ones they’d grown up alongside. That’s where I learned that doing right by others isn’t charity — it’s duty. I became a lawyer to fight for workers and families. And when my son’s elementary school — steps from the Capitol — was threatened with closure, I ran for the Austin school board. We stopped a corporate takeover of our public schools. Our schools passed accountability standards for the first time in history. A few years later, I ran for the Texas House to keep fighting for our kids and our classrooms. Since then, I’ve: ✅ Passed a first-of-its-kind law creating Public Benefit Corporations so Texas businesses can do well and do good.

✅ Secured nearly a billion dollars in federal funds for health care in Travis County.

✅ Led the charge to stop Abbott’s voucher schemes and defend public schools — beating him five times in a row.

✅ Helped organize the Democratic walkout that blocked Abbott’s voter suppression bill and protected Texans’ right to vote. Every fight has reinforced what my grandmother taught me. I can still hear her voice telling me: No te dejes. Never back down. Greg Abbott’s corruption runs deep, and the billionaires he serves will spend whatever it takes to keep him in power. But I’m not afraid of a fight, and with your help, we can finally beat him. If you believe in a Texas where every child can learn in a great public school, where families can afford health care, where every worker can earn a living wage, and where the government serves the people, not the powerful, then I need you in this fight from day one. [Peter, if you’re with me, I’m asking you to be a Founding Donor to my campaign for Governor of Texas. Split a contribution of $5, $25, $50, or more between my campaign now and Blue Amp Action.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb2d85d59-bbf8-4ee9-93b4-57da97778fc1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

clean_body: Greg Abbott works for his billionaire donors. I’m running to fight for you. | | | | | | | | | | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can. | Peter, I often think about something my grandmother used to tell me: “No te dejes.” Don’t let them push you around. Fight back. That lesson has guided me my entire life, from the Rio Grande Valley to the state legislature — and it’s why today, I’m announcing that I’m running for Governor of Texas. Because right now, Texans are in the fight of our lives for our kids, our schools, and our future. And Greg Abbott has chosen a side: the billionaires, the special interests, the big corporations, and the wealthiest donors who bankroll him. Abbott has given away nearly a billion taxpayer dollars in contracts to his campaign donors and is still scheming to rip funding away from our neighborhood schools to give to private interests. That’s corruption, plain and simple — and it’s time we fight back. If you’re ready to take our state back from Abbott and his billionaire donors, I’m asking you to be one of the first to step up: | | | I grew up in Brownsville public schools — schools where no one had much, but we had each other. My parents were legal-aid lawyers representing farmworkers and families who had nowhere else to turn. My mom was born in Mexico; my dad was the first in his family to go to college. We lived in Mission, Texas. We moved so my dad could go to Georgetown Law. My mom worked to help put my dad through school. My mom eventually decided to go to law school herself. Then, our family came home to South Texas so my parents could fight for people like the ones they’d grown up alongside. That’s where I learned that doing right by others isn’t charity — it’s duty. I became a lawyer to fight for workers and families. And when my son’s elementary school — steps from the Capitol — was threatened with closure, I ran for the Austin school board. We stopped a corporate takeover of our public schools. Our schools passed accountability standards for the first time in history. A few years later, I ran for the Texas House to keep fighting for our kids and our classrooms. Since then, I’ve: ✅ Passed a first-of-its-kind law creating Public Benefit Corporations so Texas businesses can do well and do good. ✅ Secured nearly a billion dollars in federal funds for health care in Travis County. ✅ Led the charge to stop Abbott’s voucher schemes and defend public schools — beating him five times in a row. ✅ Helped organize the Democratic walkout that blocked Abbott’s voter suppression bill and protected Texans’ right to vote. Every fight has reinforced what my grandmother taught me. I can still hear her voice telling me: No te dejes. Never back down. Greg Abbott’s corruption runs deep, and the billionaires he serves will spend whatever it takes to keep him in power. But I’m not afraid of a fight, and with your help, we can finally beat him. If you believe in a Texas where every child can learn in a great public school, where families can afford health care, where every worker can earn a living wage, and where the government serves the people, not the powerful, then I need you in this fight from day one. | | | We can do this. We’re Texans. We do hard things — and we’ve never been afraid of a fight. No te dejes. With gratitude and determination, Gina Hinojosa Candidate for Governor of Texas | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Cliff Schecter President, Blue Amp Action Amplify Good ---|--- | | | | | Follow Us | | ---|--- | Blue Amp Action PAC PO Box 8384, Cincinnati, OH 45208 | Having trouble viewing this email? | | | | | | About Blue Amp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect: after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t. When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families. Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! — You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. I’ve told you about the lawsuits I’ve filed against Trump — 42 in just 38 weeks.
The impact they’ve had is enormous: to the tune of more than $168 billion of federal funding preserved for California.
To put it simply, for every $1 we’ve been given for this work, we’ve returned $33,600 for the state.
Within his first week in office, Trump went after a full third of California’s budget. Within 24 hours, we were in court and stopped him in his tracks.
We saved money that goes to school programs for our kids, research for our future, medical care for our sick, and infrastructure that keeps our cars driving and planes in the air.
When Trump’s first big attempt to claw back funding failed, he started flooding the zone with targeted attacks. We’ve been ready to strike back at every turn. We protected more than $11 billion in federal grant funding, stopped the dismantling of federal agencies like AmeriCorps and HHS, and defended constitutional rights like birthright citizenship and the right to vote.
Trump and his allies have been leading an onslaught of near-constant attempts to cut off services and programs tens of millions of people rely on, resulting in a dangerous game of whack-a-mole with critical state funding.
But this is not a game.
When this administration targets California’s funding, they’re putting people’s education, health, livelihoods, and even their lives at risk.
That’s why every single time the President breaks the law, I will take him to court.
We’re eight months in — and we still have 40 months to go. So this is just the beginning.
I will remain unapologetic in my commitment to holding Trump accountable and defending the rights and freedoms of Californians, but I need your help to keep up this fight.
I’m on the ballot for re-election next year — and I can’t win without your support. Will you pitch in any amount to my campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan **running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss.** I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota.

I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations.

I’m an organizer, state rep, and pissed-off social worker running for Congress because we need leadership that meets this moment.
For the past decade, I’ve been at the heart of a long-term political project to take back Tennessee, shoulder to shoulder with fellow organizers, activists, movement lawyers, community groups, and mentors who took the time to teach me what real power-building looks like.
Now, I’m taking this fight national – and this special election could make history. It’s the only red-to-blue special in the country.
**If we flip this seat...Republicans lose a vote in the House, and 2026 shifts.**

Peter,

Open enrollment season is here. You know what that means.

Endless forms, higher premiums, and way too many “choices” that somehow
all feel bad.

Folks spend hours trying to figure out what’s covered, who’s in-network,
and whether they can afford their prescriptions this year.

The entire process is frustrating and confusing, but it doesn’t have to be
this way.

Right now, insurance companies have a significant impact on our healthcare
system. They jack up premiums, limit coverage, and make record profits
while working people are left holding the bill.

That’s not healthcare. That’s corporate greed.

Staying healthy shouldn’t depend on what’s in your wallet. It should be
guaranteed.

That’s why I wrote the book on Medicare for All and why I’m running to
make it a reality. Medicare for All provides holistic healthcare without
all the paperwork and bureaucracy.

Of course, that means insurance companies — the same ones with deep
pockets and powerful lobbyists — will spend big to keep someone like me
out of the Senate.

I’d rather have you on my side than them,
Peter.

| | As Donald Trump attempts to seize more control over our democracy, MAGA Republican lawmakers keep working to rip power away from voters. This year, the House GOP passed a mass voter suppression bill — the so-called SAVE Act — that could disenfranchise tens of millions of Americans through a modern-day poll tax. And that’s on top of a wave of anti-voter legislation at the state level. From the first half of 2024 to the first half of 2025, the Voting Rights Lab tracked a **50% rise in new state laws restricting access to voting.** But we’ve faced down these strategies of suppression before — and **as anti-democracy forces expand their voter suppression playbook, we’re pushing back:**
* Getting accurate information about elections into the hands of voters
* Electing voting rights champions, including in Georgia’s elections this fall
* Exposing the work of anti-voter networks
* And expanding voting access

I’m hard at work trying to reopen the government and extend the ACA tax credits that help millions afford health care.

But at the same time, my team is hustling to hit our $20,000 fundraising goal before our mid-month deadline. And at a time like this, it's crucial we hit our goals and keep up the pressure on Trump and extremist Republicans.

We're just about a year out from the midterm elections when we can finally take them to task at the ballot box for every bullsh*t thing they're doing, whether it's gutting Medicaid or driving up health care costs or making plans to push hundreds of thousands of folks off Social Security.

I’m proud our team is made up of regular Americans who care about their families, their neighbors, and their country. That’s what politics should be about – helping each other.

I know times are tough and budgets are tight. But if you can spare a few bucks tonight, it’ll go a long way toward helping us hit our $20,000 goal and keeping our fight for working families in PA + across the country. Will you chip in now to help us get there?

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51791?t=1001&akid=10365%2E434096%2E2xE3ZS

Thanks for all you do, Derek.

John ❤️

Sent from my iPhone

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.johnfetterman.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1002&akid=10365%2E434096%2E2xE3ZS

# Nancy Pelosi shouts at reporter to "SHUT UP" when asked why she did not deploy the National Guard on Jan 6
Rep. Nancy Pelosi **[snapped at a reporter on the steps of the Capitol](https://substack.com/redirect/06c5fd4f-bef9-4b16-94eb-02fab0ff57cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** today for asking why she refused to send in the National Guard to prevent the impending riot on January 6, 2021.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/06c5fd4f-bef9-4b16-94eb-02fab0ff57cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0654951c-4691-4026-ac4a-a799d4b7983b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Are you at all concerned that the new Jan 6 committee will find you liable for that day?" the reporter asked the congresswoman. "Why did you refuse to send in the National Guard on that day?"
"Shut up!" Pelosi shouted at the reporter. "I did not refuse the National Guard, thew President didn't send it! Why are you coming here with Republican talking points?!"
Video from January 6, 2021, shows then-Speaker Pelosi expressing frustration during her evacuation from the Capitol and telling her Chief of Staff Terri McCullough that she takes "responsibility" for the lack of preparedness as a mob stormed the building.
In the video, **[reviewed by Fox News Digital](https://substack.com/redirect/a3d7b135-4765-43ee-8733-9cacbd810f48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and shared by a House Republican panel, Pelosi questioned why the National Guard wasn't deployed earlier and criticized the security response, stating "We have responsibility, Terri. We did not have any accountability for what was going on there." When her aide suggested Capitol security believed they were prepared, Pelosi responded, "They clearly didn't know, and I take responsibility for not having them just prepared for more."

"What choice do they have? If they don't have the money to run the government, what are they supposed to do?" Sheehy laughed at Collins' question.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4f893ab4-b6eb-4246-b169-ad33b2a9bde5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Sheehy called out Democrats for holding the government hostage while insisting on programs that would continue to provide government healthcare for non-citizens.
"Now they're saying 'we're not going to allow the government function unless you give us $1.5 trillion for programs the American people have largely now said they are not interested in supporting, to include healthcare for non-citizens, illegal immigrants,... we're going to keep the government closed'" Sheehy explained.
