# **Teens who beat DOGE 's "Big Balls" avoid jail, sentenced to probation for assault**
Two 15-year-olds from Maryland **[pleaded guilty to simple assault and avoided jail](https://substack.com/redirect/5a0d08ed-d113-4efc-8ead-e960187fa5c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** time, with the boy receiving 12 months probation under house arrest and the girl receiving 9 months probation at a youth shelter for the August 3 attack on former DOGE staffer Edward Coristine.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9d7aadf8-0898-4998-b013-3f4e3dcd1d72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Victim suffered serious injuries:** Coristine, 19, sustained a concussion and broken nose after he and a female companion were attacked by what he described as "a group of 10 guys" in a DC parking garage at approximately 3 a.m. during an attempted carjacking.
* **Other suspects still at large:** While the two teenagers were sentenced on Tuesday, just over two months after their arrest, their accomplices in the assault and attempted carjacking remain at large, according to police.

# Mamdani addresses Trump directly during rare Fox News interview
Democratic socialist mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani **[declined Wednesday to credit President Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/84fd7ad2-2046-4603-aba9-6ed2367641cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for brokering the Middle East peace deal, telling Fox News it's "too early" to assess the agreement despite expressing hope it will endure. He then looked at the camera to deliver a message directly to the president.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/950b76cc-11bd-48e8-b7d4-c1349244a208?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Candidate addresses Trump directly:** The self-described "Democratic socialist" directly addressed President Trump in the camera during the Fox interview, stating, "I will not be a mayor like Mayor Adams, who will call you to figure out how to stay out of jail. I won't be a disgraced governor, like Andrew Cuomo, who will call you to ask how to win this election,... I can do those things on my own."
He continued, "I will, however, be a mayor who's willing to speak at any time to lower the cost of living."
* **Trump threatens to withhold federal funds:** President Trump has repeatedly vowed to cut federal funding and deploy the National Guard if Mamdani is elected, calling him a "communist" who "probably never worked a day in his life," though polls show Mamdani maintaining a double-digit lead over independent candidate Andrew Cuomo.

# **Russia to release KGB files on JFK assassination to Rep. Anna Paulina Luna- Can we trust them?**
Russia is turning over a 350-page document containing Soviet-era findings on President Kennedy's 1963 assassination to Florida Rep. Anna Paulina Luna, material that Congress sought decades ago but was unable to obtain in the 1990s, **[the NY Post reports.](https://substack.com/redirect/0b367013-df48-4b9c-af63-2844022f2cb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0b367013-df48-4b9c-af63-2844022f2cb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Authenticity concerns raised by experts:** JFK researchers including Gerald Posner and Jefferson Morley expressed skepticism about the files' reliability, noting the KGB's untrustworthy nature and questioning whether Russia's disclosure is a propaganda play to distract from tensions over Ukraine.
* **Potential insights on Lee Harvey Oswald:** The documents could provide valuable information about Oswald, whom the KGB closely monitored in the late 1950s and early 1960s, including psychiatric evaluations conducted when he defected to the Soviet Union and surveillance from his visit to a Soviet mission in Mexico City six weeks before the assassination.
* **Cuban intelligence files remain hidden:** Experts suggest that Cuban intelligence files on Oswald may be more important than the Russian documents, as reports indicate Cuba may have influenced Oswald's motivation to assassinate Kennedy, but those files have never been released.

You were at the top of it. ** This may seem small, but I promise, it matters more than you know. Your voice shapes our next move. Thanks in advance. \- Donald Trump Jr. | | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana DCDailyJournal.com This email was directed to dpwillis67@gmail.com only | Our Privacy Policy can be found by . 525-K East Market Street # 114 City: Leesburg State: Virginia Zip Code: 20176 © Copyright DCDailyJournal.com All Rights Reserved.

| | Hi Peter, it’s Lt. Gov. Davis. The Trump administration has been on a recent trend of sending the National Guard to cities and states that dare to disagree with him. Deploying these units under the guise of policing and curbing crime is dangerous and, frankly, ineffective. Especially if deterring crime is truly the goal. Through our own policies, our administration has effectively lowered gun violence rates in Pennsylvania. _None_ of it has been done by using our own military against our citizens. Instead, we’ve invested hundreds of millions of dollars into violence prevention programs across the Commonwealth. We know what it takes to keep our communities safe, and it isn’t tanks rolling down our streets. Friend, we have a problem in Congress—well, a couple.
But one of the biggest is Kevin Kiley, who's proven to us that he's nothing more than a rubber stamp for Donald Trump.
We need a trusted problem solver to help us unseat Kiley, and with over three decades of public service under her belt, we're proud that over 30 elected officials, organizations, and community leaders agree that Heidi Hall is the one for the job.
Will you join them in supporting Heidi by donating what you can to our campaign today? Your support is how we'll answer back to Kiley's billionaire donors and win this race. Chip in! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20251015_em_fr_b1_THH_BIG]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20251015_em_fr_b1_THH_BIG [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20251015_em_fr_b1_THH_BIG]
Friend, Heidi's experience is what truly sets her apart.
Her work in the EPA and as a Nevada County Supervisor has always been about delivering results and creating real meaningful change for people.
Whether it was helping protect our land and water by stopping the dumping of toxic chemical waste or listening to her community to deliver broadband access and create more economic opportunities— Heidi has always put other people first and fought for progress.
Now, she's up against one of the biggest challenges to our future in Congress, Kevin Kiley.
Friend, this seat can determine control of the House, and we need to be prepared for whatever's next. We have people like Congressman Jared Huffman, former CA-03 candidate Jessica Morse, and so many others with us on this—can we count on you too?
Will you donate to one of EMILYs List's "key flip targets" and support Heidi in this race for Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20251015_em_fr_b1_THH_BIG]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20251015_em_fr_b1_THH_BIG]
In solidarity,
Team Heidi Hall
Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20251015_em_fr_b1_THH_BIG [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20251015_em_fr_b1_THH_BIG]
Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

| Dear Friend, Five years ago, a mob tore down the Christopher Columbus statue that had stood outside our State Capitol for generations. It wasn’t just a statue; it was a tribute to the spirit of discovery and the contributions of Italian-American families who helped build our state and our nation. Since that day, Governor Tim Walz has done nothing to restore it. No accountability. No plan. Just silence. That’s why, on Columbus Day, I joined my colleagues in Congress to demand answers from Governor Walz. We asked a simple question: **Will Minnesota ever restore the Columbus statue, or will we allow mob rule to rewrite our history?** History matters. Law and order matter. And the people of Minnesota deserve leaders who will protect all of them. I’m proud to stand up for our shared heritage, for the rule of law, and for the countless Minnesotans who still believe in respecting our state, our monuments, and our story. But I can’t do it alone. The radical left and their allies in St. Paul would rather erase our past than learn from it — _**and they’ll keep pushing unless we stop them.**_ Will you chip in today to help me fight back and keep Minnesota’s values strong?

After years of hard work — we finally got it done. |

When I first ran for governor, I was hearing the same thing no matter where I was in the state. Whether I was in Marquette or Macomb, Michiganders were telling me to “fix the damn roads.” So that’s what I decided to run my campaign on. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117351967/576191204/-1313101069?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20251015_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTY1YzRlMmMtMTdhYS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cXMg_iHO8-yYiDhPL6Xz4d9gCsESp8Ce0VoW1iAdmys=) _Campaigning in 2018 to fix the damn roads!_ Now, after years of hard work, negotiation, and persistence, we finally got it done. **We just secured long-term sustainable funding to fix our roads _year after year._** Our new budget is a huge win for Michigan families, small businesses, and every driver who’s ever hit a pothole and thought: _we deserve better._ Despite the chaos in Washington, we brought people together, stayed focused, rolled up our sleeves, and never gave up. Thanks to that relentless determination, we’ve passed a budget that will improve the roads for decades to come. Now, every cent Michiganders pay at the pump goes to fixing state and local roads. I’m so proud that we finally got this done. **We can’t afford to slow down now.** Fight Like Hell PAC is working to elect and support leaders who understand the problems in their communities and work hard to deliver for them. **But our fundraising has slowed down sharply this month, and we’re only about a quarter of the way to our goal — _halfway through October._** If we don’t catch up now, we’ll have to make tough choices about where we can invest. That could mean fewer resources to defend progress, protect reproductive freedom, and keep moving Michigan forward. **[We’ve proven what’s possible when we work together. clean_body: After years of hard work — we finally got it done. | When I first ran for governor, I was hearing the same thing no matter where I was in the state. Whether I was in Marquette or Macomb, Michiganders were telling me to “fix the damn roads.” So that’s what I decided to run my campaign on. = Campaigning in 2018 to fix the damn roads! Now, after years of hard work, negotiation, and persistence, we finally got it done. We just secured long-term sustainable funding to fix our roads year after year. Our new budget is a huge win for Michigan families, small businesses, and every driver who’s ever hit a pothole and thought: we deserve better. Despite the chaos in Washington, we brought people together, stayed focused, rolled up our sleeves, and never gave up. Thanks to that relentless determination, we’ve passed a budget that will improve the roads for decades to come. Now, every cent Michiganders pay at the pump goes to fixing state and local roads. I’m so proud that we finally got this done. We can’t afford to slow down now. Fight Like Hell PAC is working to elect and support leaders who understand the problems in their communities and work hard to deliver for them. But our fundraising has slowed down sharply this month, and we’re only about a quarter of the way to our goal — halfway through October. If we don’t catch up now, we’ll have to make tough choices about where we can invest. Peter, **Federal judges are raising the alarm about the Supreme Court’s use of the shadow docket to give Trump emergency powers.** Forty-two judges, appointed by both Democrats and Republicans, say the emergency dockets have harmed public perception of the judiciary branch. **Multiple anonymous judges told the New York Times that the Supreme Court’s shadow docket abuse is a “slap in the face” to district courts, and is creating a “judicial crisis.”** 1 **Indeed, the MAGA justices have stepped in to grant Trump emergency executive powers using the shadow docket 21 times since he returned to office this year.** 2 Shadow docket decisions have allowed Trump to gut the Department of Education, cancel health research, fire thousands of federal workers, deport migrants to countries they’ve never set foot in before, and attack birthright citizenship. The shadow docket is supposed to be used in case of emergency. But when it comes to Trump, the MAGA justices are using it whenever they can to give him permission to do whatever he wants. [**Our judiciary system should hold executive power accountable, not step in to grant a wannabe dictator permission to break the law. Tell the Supreme Court to stop abusing the shadow docket. clean_body: This is how we build power for climate action. | = I’ve known Jane Fonda for more than 50 years. We've shared movie sets, red carpets, and picket lines. We've even been arrested together on the steps of the Capitol for demanding climate action. I'm proud to call her a dear friend, and I fully believe in the work of her climate PAC — especially now, when the very fabric of our democracy and our planet is being tested every single day. You’ve seen it for yourself. Donald Trump is doing everything in his power to prop up corporate polluters who don’t give a damn about you, me, or the very people who voted for him. He’s cut taxes for his fossil fuel buddies, opened millions of acres of public lands to drilling, gutted protections for our air and water, and fired scientists who dare speak the truth. These aren’t abstract decisions — they hurt real people, real communities, and real families. But when I start to lose hope, I look to Jane, and to the work her team is doing at JanePAC, and it reminds me that change is still possible. They aren't waiting around for Washington to do the right thing. They're building power from the ground up by electing climate champions at every level of government in races that rarely make headlines but change lives and shape the policy that protects us from Trump's attacks. Since 2022, Jane and her team have helped elect over 160 climate leaders nationwide. Now, with critical races in Virginia, Pennsylvania, Georgia, and beyond coming down to the wire, we have a historic opportunity to help them elect dozens more this November. That's why I'm reaching out today. COMING UP:
Informing and empowering communities with more Civics 101 workshops
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2%20-%20Civics%20101.jpg]
Governing bodies — from the local, state, to federal level — impact our lives as well as those of our family, friends, and neighbors each and every day. With so many elected offices, it can be tough to tell which officials are responsible for carrying out which duties. That's where we come in to help — to inform and share an overview of current events that connects government to our daily lives.
Attend the following Civics 101 workshops we're hosting, to get a refresher on the fundamentals of our democracy, and to learn about the statewide propositions that will be on your ballot this upcoming election.
• Tuesday, October 21 in Fort Worth (Contact Ariana at aperez@organizetexas.org [aperez@organizetexas.org] for event details).
• Wednesday, October 22 in San Antonio (Contact Luis at lramirez@organizetexas.org [lramirez@organizetexas.org] for event details).
REMEMBER: Early voting in the Texas constitutional amendments election starts October 20 and goes through October 31. Election Day is November 4.
ADD YOUR NAME:
Join the campaign against unfair rent price setting in Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rent%20increase%20form.jpg]
Housing is a human right, and as costs for basic goods continue to rise in this Trump economy, so is rent. Join our campaign fighting back.
TOP and DFW housing justice allies are urging the City of Dallas to ban the use of property management software RealPage [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/what-is-realpage--and-why-is-it-being-blamed-for-raising-everyones-rent-184647022.html] , as well as other real estate platforms that engage in algorithmic price setting.
RealPage is currently under investigation by the U.S. Dept. of Justice and faces multiple lawsuits from states and cities for violating antitrust laws.
https://secure.everyaction.com/NXgD0nS8F02LVZwJDOVXgQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/NXgD0nS8F02LVZwJDOVXgQ2]
For more information on this campaign, contact Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Honoring our Indigenous brothers and sisters
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Better%20Indigenous-Peoples-Day.jpeg]
Organizing to advance racial and economic justice, TOP proudly joined in honoring the past, present, and future of Indigenous people throughout not just the United States, but the world this Indigenous Peoples’ Day. Together, we recognize the vast histories, vibrant cultures, and invaluable contributions of our Indigenous brothers and sisters who have shaped society since the start of recorded history. We also acknowledge the destructive legacy of colonization in this country, rooted in white supremacy, which led to state-sanctioned atrocities, forced assimilation, and the violent removal of Indigenous tribes from ancestral lands spanning generations.
The reverberations of these injustices sadly continue to be felt to this day, and can be seen through disparities that exist for Indigenous communities in areas such healthcare, education, housing, and the environment – issues central to our movement for collective liberation – as we work to build solidarity across communities of color to dismantle the systemic racism that for far too long has held us back. Through observing Indigenous Peoples' Day, we celebrate the inherent beauty and resilience of our Indigenous communities, while reaffirming their full right to sovereignty, self-determination, and dignity.

PRÓXIMAMENTE:
Informando y empoderando a las comunidades con más talleres de Cívica 101
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2%20-%20Civics%20101.jpg]
Los órganos de gobierno, desde el nivel local, estatal y federal, impactan nuestras vidas, así como las de nuestros familiares, amigos y vecinos, a diario. Con tantos cargos electos, puede ser difícil determinar qué funcionarios son responsables de cada función. Ahí es donde entramos para ayudar: para informar y compartir un resumen de eventos actuales que conectan al gobierno con nuestra vida diaria.
Asiste a los siguientes talleres de Cívica 101 que estamos organizando para repasar los fundamentos de nuestra democracia y conocer las propuestas estatales que estarán en su boleta electoral en las próximas elecciones.
• Martes 21 de octubre en Fort Worth (Contacta a Ariana en aperez@organizetexas.org [aperez@organizetexas.org] para obtener más detalles).
• Miercoles 22 de octubre en San Antonio (Contacta a Luis en lramirez@organizetexas.org [lramirez@organizetexas.org] para obtener más detalles).
RECUERDE: La votación anticipada en las elecciones de enmiendas constitucionales de Texas comienza el 20 de octubre y continúa hasta el 31 de octubre. El día de la elección es el 4 de noviembre.
AGREGA TU NOMBRE:
Únete a la campaña contra los precios injustos de alquiler en Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rent%20increase%20form.jpg]
La vivienda es un derecho humano, y a medida que los precios de los bienes básicos siguen aumentando en esta economía de Trump, también lo hace el alquiler. Únete a nuestra campaña para luchar.
TOP y aliados de DFW en materia de justicia habitacional instan a la ciudad de Dallas a prohibir el uso del software de administración de propiedades RealPage [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/what-is-realpage--and-why-is-it-being-blamed-for-raising-everyones-rent-184647022.html] , así como otras plataformas inmobiliarias que utilizan algoritmos para fijar precios.
RealPage está siendo investigado por el Departamento de Justicia de EE. UU. y enfrenta múltiples demandas de estados y ciudades por violar las leyes antimonopolio.

Para obtener más información sobre esta campaña, contacta con Iman en ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Honrando a nuestros hermanos y hermanas indígenas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Better%20Indigenous-Peoples-Day.jpeg]
Organizando para promover la justicia racial y económica, TOP se unió con orgullo para honrar el pasado, el presente y el futuro de los pueblos indígenas, no sólo en Estados Unidos, sino en todo el mundo, en este Día de los Pueblos Indígenas. Juntos, reconocemos las vastas historias, las vibrantes culturas y las invaluables contribuciones de nuestros hermanos y hermanas indígenas que han forjado la sociedad desde el inicio de la historia escrita. También reconocemos el legado destructivo de la colonización en este país, arraigado en la supremacía blanca, que condujo a atrocidades sancionadas por el Estado, la asimilación forzada y la expulsión violenta de tribus indígenas de sus tierras ancestrales a lo largo de generaciones.
Las repercusiones de estas injusticias, lamentablemente, continúan sintiéndose hasta el día de hoy, y se pueden ver en las disparidades que existen para las comunidades indígenas en áreas como la salud, la educación, la vivienda y el medio ambiente —temas centrales para nuestro movimiento por la liberación colectiva— mientras trabajamos para construir solidaridad entre las comunidades de color para desmantelar el racismo sistémico que durante demasiado tiempo nos ha frenado. Al celebrar el Día de los Pueblos Indígenas, celebramos la belleza inherente y la resiliencia de nuestras comunidades indígenas, al tiempo que reafirmamos su pleno derecho a la soberanía, la autodeterminación y la dignidad.

clean_body: [] Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español] COMING UP: Informing and empowering communities with more Civics 101 workshops [] Governing bodies — from the local, state, to federal level — impact our lives as well as those of our family, friends, and neighbors each and every day. With so many elected offices, it can be tough to tell which officials are responsible for carrying out which duties. That's where we come in to help — to inform and share an overview of current events that connects government to our daily lives. Attend the following Civics 101 workshops we're hosting, to get a refresher on the fundamentals of our democracy, and to learn about the statewide propositions that will be on your ballot this upcoming election. • Tuesday, October 21 in Fort Worth (Contact Ariana at aperez@organizetexas.org [aperez@organizetexas.org] for event details). • Wednesday, October 22 in San Antonio (Contact Luis at lramirez@organizetexas.org [lramirez@organizetexas.org] for event details). REMEMBER: Early voting in the Texas constitutional amendments election starts October 20 and goes through October 31. Election Day is November 4. ADD YOUR NAME: Join the campaign against unfair rent price setting in Dallas [] Housing is a human right, and as costs for basic goods continue to rise in this Trump economy, so is rent. Join our campaign fighting back. TOP and DFW housing justice allies are urging the City of Dallas to ban the use of property management software RealPage [] , as well as other real estate platforms that engage in algorithmic price setting. RealPage is currently under investigation by the U.S. Dept. of Justice and faces multiple lawsuits from states and cities for violating antitrust laws. [] For more information on this campaign, contact Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] . Honoring our Indigenous brothers and sisters [] Organizing to advance racial and economic justice, TOP proudly joined in honoring the past, present, and future of Indigenous people throughout not just the United States, but the world this Indigenous Peoples’ Day. Together, we recognize the vast histories, vibrant cultures, and invaluable contributions of our Indigenous brothers and sisters who have shaped society since the start of recorded history. We also acknowledge the destructive legacy of colonization in this country, rooted in white supremacy, which led to state-sanctioned atrocities, forced assimilation, and the violent removal of Indigenous tribes from ancestral lands spanning generations. The reverberations of these injustices sadly continue to be felt to this day, and can be seen through disparities that exist for Indigenous communities in areas such healthcare, education, housing, and the environment – issues central to our movement for collective liberation – as we work to build solidarity across communities of color to dismantle the systemic racism that for far too long has held us back. Through observing Indigenous Peoples' Day, we celebrate the inherent beauty and resilience of our Indigenous communities, while reaffirming their full right to sovereignty, self-determination, and dignity. subject: Health care costs are about to skyrocket
body:
|
#
Friend, **I want to be straight with you: health care costs are about to rise — fast — if Congress doesn’t act soon.** The Affordable Care Act tax credits that help Americans afford coverage are about to expire. That means higher premiums for families already feeling squeezed: | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117353109/576194525/797172823?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDI4NTdhZC0xYWFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-4GcXF7eAC3EFEBVBdlNdhXiyf133cLLdam_QagrJ-U=&emci=36660125-bea9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=442857ad-1aaa-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=27257697) **Affordable Care Act premiums will rise 114% if enhanced subsidies expire**
---
These tax credits help more than 20 million people afford coverage, saving folks hundreds of dollars a month on health insurance. If they expire, families here in Michigan and across the country could see their premiums double — or even triple — overnight.
**That’s people’s lives turned upside down in an instant.**
I’m fighting to extend these critical ACA subsidies and to pass a budget that protects health care for working families — not cut it to fund giveaways for billionaires.
Because this shouldn’t be a partisan issue. Access to affordable health care is something every American deserves — no matter your politics, where you live, or what’s in your bank account.
And when I talk to families across mid-Michigan, I hear the same thing again and again: people just want stability. They want to know that when they work hard and play by the rules, they can afford the basics — food, housing, and health care.

clean_body: | Friend, I want to be straight with you: health care costs are about to rise — fast — if Congress doesn’t act soon. The Affordable Care Act tax credits that help Americans afford coverage are about to expire. That means higher premiums for families already feeling squeezed: | Affordable Care Act premiums will rise 114% if enhanced subsidies expire These tax credits help more than 20 million people afford coverage, saving folks hundreds of dollars a month on health insurance. If they expire, families here in Michigan and across the country could see their premiums double — or even triple — overnight. That’s people’s lives turned upside down in an instant. I’m fighting to extend these critical ACA subsidies and to pass a budget that protects health care for working families — not cut it to fund giveaways for billionaires. Because this shouldn’t be a partisan issue. Access to affordable health care is something every American deserves — no matter your politics, where you live, or what’s in your bank account. And when I talk to families across mid-Michigan, I hear the same thing again and again: people just want stability. They want to know that when they work hard and play by the rules, they can afford the basics — food, housing, and health care. | Thank you, Kristen | = | We'd hate to see you go, but you can click here if you'd like to . name: Justice Democrats
subject: Our eyes are still on Gaza
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

One week ago, Israel and Hamas reached a long-awaited ceasefire agreement.

Since then, the last 20 living Israeli hostages have all returned home,
while about 1,700 Palestinians held in Israeli captivity without any legal
charges or outside communication were released. Many of the Palestinian
hostages returned with amputated limbs and clear signs of torture and
mistreatment.

While this is a necessary reprieve to the endless violence this genocide
has inflicted, this agreement could and should have happened much sooner.
This deal was on the table since 2023 — had President Biden pressured
Benjamin Netanyahu to accept it during his administration, it would have
saved an untold number of lives from bombardment, shootings, and
starvation.

So far, the ceasefire is incredibly fragile and has already been violated
by the Israeli government repeatedly in the last few days, including by
killing at least nine Palestinians, reducing the agreed-upon amount of aid
allowed into Gaza by half (from 600 to 300 trucks per day), and blocking
fuel and gas shipments.

The Israeli government must start allowing the free flow of food, medical
supplies, and other aid into Gaza to prevent further starvation, and we
must demand that Palestinians are in the driver's seat for their own
self-determination — not Tony Blair, Donald Trump, or Benjamin Netanyahu.

Not only that, but we cannot let Netanyahu’s far-right government revert
back to its genocide and ethnic cleansing of Gaza — and the struggle for
Palestinian freedom must continue until we demand an end to Israeli
apartheid, occupation, and ethnic cleansing. That starts with ending all
U.S. funding to the Israeli government.

As Justice Democrats’ Rep. Summer Lee said, “We owe it to every
Palestinian killed, every home and hospital destroyed, to demand
accountability for the war crimes committed, and we must keep pushing for
an end to the occupation.”

Let’s make it clear that our eyes are still on Gaza and we are committed
to the ongoing fight for peace and justice for ALL.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

name: Team Kelly
subject: Mark’s story — (PHOTOS)
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Growing up, this little boy learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct25.Iw7SM3&refcode=em251015-2-700k&t=1&akid=6218%2E6688874%2EBJQ6JB)
At the age of 23, he became a United States naval aviator. He deployed twice on the U.S.S. Midway and flew 39 combat missions in Operation Desert Storm.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct25.Iw7SM3&refcode=em251015-2-700k&t=2&akid=6218%2E6688874%2EBJQ6JB)
Then, at the age of 32, he was selected as an astronaut (with his twin brother, Scott!). He flew his first of four missions into space in 2001 aboard Space Shuttle Endeavour. He spent more than 50 days in space and has lived on the International Space Station.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct25.Iw7SM3&refcode=em251015-2-700k&t=3&akid=6218%2E6688874%2EBJQ6JB)
In 2011, Mark's wife, Former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, was shot in Tucson during an event where she was meeting with her constituents. Hi Peter,
I’ve spent my career standing up to hapless Trump officials and clueless CEOs. I stood up to the Big Banks and helped deliver billions to keep Californians in their homes.
Now, I’m running for Governor.
We are in a moment when Donald Trump is literally shaking the foundations of our democracy and wrecking our economy. You can be sure as hell that I am not going to let him get away with hurting our state.
It’s no secret that I’m tough, and I’ve got high expectations for the people running our government, our economy, and myself. We all should. Californians can expect me to be just as strong and tough when I’m looking out for their interests.
I just talked to Nikki Laurenzo about the past week and moments that I could’ve handled things better. The bottom line? I’ll be the fighter that Californians deserve. [Watch >>](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3EzawS0AEPc)

Thanks for having my back. I’ll always have yours.
Thank you,
Katie Porter

Since the end of WWI, the Middle East has been a political nightmare. At the San Remo Conference in 1920, the League of Nations created arbitrary borders for new countries. The architects of this process failed to consider the makeup of the groups/tribes that resided within these arbitrary lines.
Most importantly, these planners had no knowledge of the tribal and feudal warfare between so many diverse groups. After more than a hundred years, this same barbarism endures.
The British, as their empire was beginning to decline, further complicated matters by giving control of Iraq and Jordan (then Trans Jordan) to the Hashemite tribe. This tribe had ruled the Arabian Peninsula for several hundred years and controlled the holy Islamic sites of Mecca and Medina. The Hashemite tribe was defeated by the Sauds, another tribal nation that ruled the region that is presently Saudi Arabia.
Because the Hashemites allied with and helped the British defeat the Turks in WWI, following their Saudi exile, they were rewarded with the control of Iraq and Jordan as their new homeland.
This decision to place a colonizing Arabian Peninsula Tribe in charge of other people's land further complicated matters of the Middle East.
Under the terms of the original San Remo Agreement, the region that is now called Jordan, the West Bank and Israel were supposed to be divided into two countries. The Arab population was to be given Jordan, which represented over 80% of the land and the Jews were supposed to get all of the land west of the Jordan River.
Because the Hashemites took control of an area comprised of 70% ethnic Palestinian Arabs in Jordan, the San Remo Agreement was never implemented. Had the land been divided as originally planned in 1920, we would have never had the problems we have today.
The second problem was the rise of the Muslim Brotherhood, a Jihadist based, organization that believes that neither the Jews nor the Christians should control any Muslim land.
Starting in the 1920's they started violent riots against the Jews in the British controlled land that is now Israel and Judea and Samaria. Their teachings and ideology expanded during WWII where the Palestinian Arab population aligned with the Nazis who shared their same ideology of wanting to kill all the Jews in the British controlled Palestinian Mandate.
That same hatred and ideology has continued with the offshoots of the Muslim Brotherhood including Hamas and the Palestinian Authority.
For over one hundred years, Palestinian Arabs have been taught that they have a religious duty and sacred directive to hate and kill Jews.
**This hundred plus years of poisonous ideology must be reversed if there is ever to be peace. That is going to be a monumental task that will take time and re-education. Without this change in attitude there will never be lasting peace.**
The ceasefire and prisoner exchange for civilian Israeli hostages reveals a potential turning point as other Arab countries and Turkey that have typically supported the Palestinians have shifted priorities.
These nations participation in the ceasefire process demonstrates that Israel is a much more formidable military power than they expected. They also have to be concerned that there are extensive Israeli assets and weapons in their countries that can be deployed like in Iran with Operation Rising Lion. They might also fear that any of their smart devices may explode if they cross Israel after the pager incident that wounded and killed so many radical Hezbollah leaders.
In last two years since October 7, 2023, Israel has defeated two of the largest terrorist organizations, Hamas in Gaza and Hezbollah in Lebanon. They also have destroyed the military capability of the terror state of Iran and wiped out the nuclear reactors of Iran with the aid of its greatest ally, the United States. Israel has also shown that they can reach the Gulf States by shooting long range missiles from the air.
Israel is a technologically advanced country, and that same military ingenuity can be used for collaboration with their Arab neighbors for greater economic prosperity in the region. This is the major objective of the Abraham Accords that began more than five years ago.
The fear of Israel's military power coupled with its economic strength and support of the United States and especially President Trump who exemplified his Art of the Deal ceasefire has led to a shift in attitude of major Arab players with Monday's historic meeting in Egypt. While the hostages are home the process is far from over.
However this shift to focus on working with Israel is long overdue. Over one hundred years ago, Emir Faisal, the leader of the post WWI Arab population supported the Jewish state of Israel. Fasial had the foresight and ability to see that Israel would lead scientific and technological breakthroughs that would benefit the Middle East. The Abraham Accords of President Trump's administration represented the beginning of the achievement of this reality that Faisal envisioned.
President Trump's new peace agreement will further accelerate the process. As countries shift focus away from supporting the Jihadist policy of Hamas and other terrorist forces and focus on their own economic prosperity, Israel will become an key important partner, especially with some of the greatest technology and innovation in the region.
This is why there is hope and optimism for the future and a new willingness for the Arab countries and Turkey to embrace the Trump Peace Plan.
Cautious optimism, hard work, strong US support and a desire for a brighter future are the driving forces for success. One hundred years of hatred, indoctrination and the loss of economic and political benefits to the terrorist organization are the stumbling blocks as is the United Nations.
On the same day of the release of the hostages, Hamas forces executed numerous Palestinians in Gaza that were suspected to have supported Israel. This mass killing drew no outcry or outrage or condemnation from the Free Palestine supporters and the United Nations. They fell far short of Dag Hammarskjold, the Second Secretary- General of the United Nations who said in his speech in 1954 that : "It has been said that the United Nations was not created in order to bring us to heaven, but in order to save us from hell"?
Well, Hell is here and present throughout the terror forces that reign in Gaza, Syria and throughout the world and the United Nations has not responded or acknowledged the atrocities of Hamas and so many others.
This is another benefit of the Abraham Accords and The Trump Peace Plan and cease-fire - It does not require any assistance or interference from the United Nations. This agreement proves how useless the UN has become when all Arab nations walked out on Bibi Netanyahu's address to the General Assembly and the intentional scheduling of Security Council briefings on Gaza on Rosh Hashanah when Israel was unable to attend.
Cautious optimism is all we can hope for despite the initial reaction to the release of all live hostages while the remains of so many others still remain in Gaza, including two American citizens, Nineteen-year-old U.S.-Israeli dual citizen [Itay Chen](https://substack.com/redirect/87f95985-55a3-43ba-adb8-2a0e7477d231?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Capt. Omer Neutra](https://substack.com/redirect/d236b00e-e1fa-422f-9ad6-6ef46cbf259d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), 21, a fellow American-Israeli from New York.
Healing is beginning but true healing may not happen until closure occurs. In the meantime, we hope that a new window of opportunity has opened, but it will require extensive work to make these potential economic partnerships thrive.

body:
Nancy is "incorruptible!"| | | _Click here if you wish to unsubscribe_
---

| **Dear Friend,** As your Congressman for North Carolina's 8th District, I’ve fought tirelessly on the House Judiciary Committee to uphold faith, family, and freedom.

Today, I’m reaching out with urgency: crime in Democrat-run cities is spiraling out of control, threatening our communities. From Charlotte to cities nationwide, Democratic mayors’ policies—defunding police, no-bail releases, and neglecting law enforcement—are failing us. Families fear for their safety, businesses are closing due to theft and violence, and innocent lives, like Iryna Zarutska’s, are lost to repeat offenders set free.

As a pastor and Congressman, I believe we must protect the vulnerable, not embolden criminals. **That’s why I’m leading Republican efforts to pass the No Funding for Lawless Jurisdictions Act and Cashless Bail Reporting Act, holding these cities accountable by cutting federal funds that enable their reckless policies. **But I need your help. The radical left is doubling down, and Washington is a battleground. Your donation today will fuel our fight to restore law and order, back our police, and keep our streets safe.

Mark Harris

* * *
All right, folks--buckle up, because today's show was one of those that slaps your ass and calls you Sally. Or, to put it less colloquially, it makes you remember exactly what's at stake in this country.
Our guest, Wayne Besen, didn't just bring the receipts--he brought the carbon copies. And also some goddamn fire.
By the time he was done laying out what Project 2025 _really_ is--it's various semi-congealed theocratic, totalitarian, incel-ian parts--I wanted [to grab a megaphone, march straight to the Capitol,](https://substack.com/redirect/26ebbfc6-1f3e-4798-847c-ce0b15a5ef01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and scream, "_**Under His Eye My Arse**_."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/80b4821e-b939-4b8d-92ae-b2bfd679a636?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let's start with the basics. I'm sure you've heard of "Project 2025," the Heritage Foundation's 900-plus-page manifesto of febrile, fascist fantasies. It's _War & Peace_ for the aspiring Pinochet or Pol Pot in your life.
Pornhub for Christian Nationalists.
An authoritarian [wish list designed to replace democracy with dictatorship](https://substack.com/redirect/faf82a6c-deef-4728-af02-293c900d4a2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To chuck expertise for some good old fashioned zealotry. To turn citizens into obedient subjects (and good little consumers).
But Wayne--founder of Truth Wins Out--went deeper.
He's been mapping out the 114 organizations behind this beast. And his findings? Chilling. Project 2025, he says, is the _sanitized_ version. The real agenda--the raw, unfiltered, Dominionist delusion--is hiding in plain site with the groups that are funding and feeding it.
Wayne broke it down like this: There are three major power centers trying to reshape America into their image of hell and "[they're all tied closely to JD Vance."](https://substack.com/redirect/137d0fb1-f769-4f4d-a983-a5fae2d70b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
First, you've got **Donald Trump** , the orange-hued cult leader who can summon a mob (likely also "the mob") faster than you can say "dictator chic."
Second, **Peter Thiel 's Silicon Valley techno-oligarchs**, [those self-anointed tech-bro geniuses](https://substack.com/redirect/137d0fb1-f769-4f4d-a983-a5fae2d70b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Hobbes and Nietzsche of cads who'd rather code than talk to other humans. The ones who gave us our current social media landscape, built in their awkward, discount-personality image.
They think democracy is a bug, not a feature. To paraphrase sweaty weirdo Thiel from a few years back, democracy gets in the way of capitalism. So democracy must go.
* * *
Support real journalism.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.PH57X0yoQzwA-NOYXRDFXBKjVhhlKC3pNw-tY7saFqo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=176254131)
* * *
[And third, the ](https://substack.com/redirect/137d0fb1-f769-4f4d-a983-a5fae2d70b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Project 2025 zealots](https://substack.com/redirect/137d0fb1-f769-4f4d-a983-a5fae2d70b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/137d0fb1-f769-4f4d-a983-a5fae2d70b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)led by Russell Vought, the guy whose idea of a good time is dismantling the federal government with the same passion most teenagers reserve for sports or Marvel movies.
Senator Mike Lee--you know the guy who made online jokes while Melissa Hortman's murderer was still being hunted--said Vought has been waiting for this government shutdown "since puberty."
This dude must have been the life of the party growing up--the party being this joker alone at home with his joystick.
And lurking under it all, are the religious extremists--Opus Dei Catholics, fundamentalist evangelicals--the people who literally want to turn America into a _Christian Iran (_ and make up a majority of our current Supreme Court).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/137d0fb1-f769-4f4d-a983-a5fae2d70b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Think that's hyperbole? It's not. These people are building a database--a _surge_ of personnel ready to flood every agency the moment Trump can fire, suspend or push out an expert to create an opening. [They call it "personnel is policy." ](https://substack.com/redirect/725b18a6-731c-40b0-a89d-2274dd8f9ec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's polite D.C. code for: _replace scientists with snake-handlers, generals with grifters, teachers with theocrats._
They're not downsizing government, they're giving it the equivalent of an unceasing computer virus.
You want to work for air traffic control? Better have the right views on abortion. You want to teach civics? Linda McMahon's Project 2025 buddies--_the same ones who backed the Big Lie_ --will be writing the curriculum.
Orwell would call it satire. These freaks call it Tuesday.
And can we also pause here a second to marvel at the fact that the person who created our own version of Rome's "bread and circuses," the WWE, was put in charge of education?
S*t, Nero didn't even have the gall to do that.
#### **🔥[We're Gearing Up For "No Kings Day" This Saturday! Support Our Efforts & Get All Our Coverage With A Paid Subscription!](https://substack.com/redirect/dfdabd36-1cbc-4c5d-be04-ec915ca5662f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)🔥**
[I Support No Kings Day!](https://substack.com/redirect/35803aad-8233-4a01-b31f-ba5a4f85d74a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Wayne didn't mince words.
He warned that LGBTQ Americans, women, immigrants, and anyone who doesn't bow to Project 2025's pseudo-Christian nationalism are in the crosshairs. Their version of America doesn't just roll back rights--[it erases entire communities.](https://substack.com/redirect/d2a0e778-7e59-4278-ad5f-bc73ee9f9325?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
These people aren't conserving anything; they're replacing everything. He calls it _their_ "Great Replacement"--deport immigrants, legalize child labor, and use "parental rights" as a smokescreen for exploitation. It's Dickens meets dystopia.
_It was the worst of times. And also it was the worst of times._
And it's not just culture--they're wrecking competence itself. Wayne, David Shuster and I talked about how they've purged the experts who keep the lights on, the planes flying, the data honest.
Fire the meteorologists, ignore the scientists, replace the generals with weekend-anchor Fox hosts.

Caring for Andy showed me what’s at stake — and it’s why I’ll never stop fighting for accessible and affordable health care for all.
#
**Protecting people’s health care is worth the fight.**
My husband Andy was diagnosed with terminal cancer one year into our relationship, and I became his primary caregiver.
We were lucky that Andy had access to health care — but **that experience showed me how fragile access can be, and how devastating it is when people don’t have it.**
That’s why I’ll never back down from the fight to protect access to health care — no matter how much Republicans try to cut it.
We must reopen the government and protect access to health care. **This fight is worth it, and I’m proud to be in it with you.**
[**If you can, I hope you’ll pitch in $25 or $10 right now to help power our movement to protect health care and build a government that works for everyone.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251015-1.K6pnY_&refcode=em20251015-2411&t=1&akid=2411%2E21716%2ECu5UcP)
